title: Data Engineer
description:
Overview

Ready to launch your data career on work that matters to national defense? As FWI’s Data Engineer on the DA2I program, you’ll collect, clean, and transform raw data into the trusted, well-governed datasets that power financial management decisions across the Department of War. If you want your Python, SQL, and Databricks skills to support a real DoW mission, not just another reporting task, this is the seat.

FWI is building a team to support the Department of War Comptroller and as a Data Engineer, you will play a crucial role in building and maintaining reliable datasets and analytics pipelines, using Python, SQL, R, Databricks, and Spark to improve data quality, availability, and reporting for mission-critical decision-making

FWI is expanding rapidly and has been recognized as a 2024, 2025 and 2026 Top Workplace, offering excellent growth opportunities in a collaborative environment.

Work Schedule and Location:

Hybrid: This role is based in Arlington, Virginia and works on a hybrid schedule, typically 1–2 days on site per month, with the balance remote. We are looking for someone in the National Capital Region who can be on site when the mission calls for it, not only on a fixed schedule. Working alongside the government team in person is part of how this role builds the relationships the work depends on.

Responsibilities

  • Collect, clean, and transform raw data into meaningful, actionable information.
  • Help implement analytical techniques and applications that use data-oriented programming languages, visualization tools, and modern computational methods.
  • Apply foundational data mining, data modeling, natural language processing, and machine learning techniques to extract insights from large structured and unstructured datasets.
  • Visualize, interpret, and clearly report data findings, occasionally developing dynamic or automated data reports for stakeholders.
  • Analyze data patterns and validate data quality to keep information accurate and reliable.
  • Assist with troubleshooting data workflows and support senior data scientists in maintaining stable, well-governed analytics pipelines.
  • Improve data availability, transparency, and mission-critical decision-making across enterprise systems.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Up to 3 years of directly related experience and a B.A./B.S. degree.
  • Up to 3 years of foundational experience using Python, SQL, R, or similar languages for data manipulation, ETL, or analytics workflows.
  • Exposure to data-processing frameworks or platforms (e.g., Databricks, Spark, or equivalent) and familiarity with mapping raw-to-scrubbed data stages.
  • Understanding of basic analytical concepts such as data mining, machine learning fundamentals, NLP techniques, and data modeling.
  • Ability to perform data validation, identify anomalies, and support data-quality governance under guidance from senior team members.
  • Ability to interpret trends, visualize results, and communicate data findings using dashboards and modern visualization tools.
  • Active Secret clearance.

Desired:

  • Exposure to mission-focused analytics platforms and large-scale enterprise datasets.
  • Familiarity with audit workflows, financial data environments, or systems involving structured and semi-structured data integrations.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and translating business requirements into basic analytical or software tasks.
  • Experience building lightweight scripts or prototypes that automate small analytical tasks or data transformations.

FWI is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability/vets.

Why Join Our Team

At FWI, we place the highest importance on creating an exceptional employee experience. You'll have opportunities to achieve your career aspirations through internal promotions, professional development, and other recognition and rewards programs. Join our team and take advantage of the many benefits we offer, including:

  • Health Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Long-term and Short-term Disability Insurance
  • Life Insurance
  • 401(k) Plan
  • Holiday Pay
  • Paid Time Off

Pay Range

$45.38 per hour to $49.64 per hour, depending on experience, education and clearance level.

description:
Support us in designing the insurance experience of the future. As a Governance & Legal Associate (all genders), you will provide day-to-day support across data protection, contracts, and regulatory matters for our European business. You will handle data protection matters and risk assessments, prepare and review contracts, and support insurance-regulatory compliance, working closely with the Head of Governance and relevant corporate group functions. You will bring solid expertise across these areas, combined with a pragmatic, structured, and detail-oriented approach. The ideal candidate combines solid know-how in these areas with a structured, hands-on way of working and enjoys getting into the operational detail of day-to-day matters.

This is a full-time hybrid role, with 1-2 days per week working from our Berlin office.

Requirements

  • Prepare, review, and negotiate Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) and related contractual clauses within established templates / frames
  • Handle and coordinate Data Subject Rights (DSR) requests, ensuring timely and compliant responses

  • Support the implementation of automated solutions (e.g. DSR workflows, data mapping tools)

Contract Support

title: Founding Engineer
description:
Location: Remote, US or LATAM

Type: flexible

Compensation: Competitive cash + equity compensation; tailored to the candidate

The Role

This is a senior, hands-on founding engineering role with ownership of architecture, infrastructure, and engineering execution. You will strengthen and extend an established production platform, leading the existing engineering team.

You will take full ownership of technical decisions, implementation quality, and production operation. Josh leads product priorities and brings deep infrastructure-finance expertise; you translate those priorities into sound engineering decisions and dependable software. You will work with Josh and our financial modeling team to understand complex workflows and build reusable platform capabilities. Josh owns customer communication and discovery during the initial phase.

We are hiring for judgment and track record: someone who can evaluate an existing foundation, make disciplined tradeoffs, and lead delivery while remaining deeply involved in the code.

What You'll Own

Strong data modeling, calculation orchestration, integrations, versioning, and production reliability are central to this role, alongside the ability to deliver a complete customer-facing application.

1. Product and Application Engineering

Build the product end to end on the existing stack of Next.js, React, TypeScript, and a .net C# excel control layer. Design robust financial data models, reliable calculation orchestration, source-system integrations, and scenario and version controls. Make outputs traceable and reproducible, with reconciliation and review where required. Deliver clear, responsive interfaces for complex financial workflows.

2. Infrastructure and Architecture

Own and evolve the existing architecture, services, data layer, infrastructure as code, deployment environments, observability, and CI/CD. Make build-versus-buy decisions and lead technical planning and execution. Strengthen testing, performance, recovery, and release practices as deployments and usage grow. Turn customer requirements into shared capabilities, configuration, or bounded extensions.

3. Security and Sensitive Data

Own the engineering controls that protect confidential customer financial data: authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, encryption, access control, and audit trails. Maintain reliable production operation through monitoring, backups, incident response, and controlled deployment and rollback. You are accountable for implementation and operation.

4. Product Collaboration and Team Leadership

Partner with the CEO and financial modelers to translate customer requirements into technical designs, implementation plans, and software with clear acceptance criteria. Own engineering delivery and production readiness, with customer communication led by the CEO. There is potential for this role to participate directly in and own parts of that discovery and workflow over time once domain fluency is proven. Guide and mentor the engineering team, maintain code-review and delivery standards, and help assess future engineering hires.

Early Success

  • Deliver the remaining product and platform capabilities required to serve clients #3 & #4 in production.

  • Prepare Inframodel to scale across the market in 2027 through maintainable architecture, production reliability, and engineering practices that support a growing customer base and team.

Who We're Looking For

Must have

  • Experience building and shipping financial-modeling-oriented enterprise SaaS. You understand how financial assumptions, calculations, scenarios, and outputs interact, and have translated that logic into production software for finance users.

  • 10+ years building and shipping production software.

  • Demonstrated ownership of architecture, infrastructure, and production engineering, including infrastructure as code.

  • Deep experience with data modeling, calculation orchestration, integrations, versioning, and production reliability.

  • Strong full-stack command of TypeScript, React, and Next.js, with sound product and interface judgment.

  • Experience protecting sensitive financial data in enterprise software.

  • Experience building new products or substantial capabilities in a small team.

  • Professional-level English and the ability to clearly explain technical decisions and tradeoffs to the founder and internal team.

  • Ability to independently own architecture, infrastructure, and engineering execution without requiring senior technical oversight.

Background we're targeting

You have owned complex financial software from architecture through production use. Relevant backgrounds include enterprise financial modeling, planning and forecasting, or fintech platforms where financial calculation and scenario logic are core to the product. We value evidence that you can combine hands-on delivery with sound architecture and operational discipline.

Nice to have

These strengthen an application but are not required.

  • Energy, infrastructure, or project-finance experience.

  • Experience with calculation engines, Excel automation, model parsing, or governed spreadsheet integration.

  • Experience scaling enterprise deployments through shared product capabilities and configuration.

  • A track record as an early engineer whose systems continued to operate and evolve.

  • Experience applying AI to financial workflows with source traceability, validation, and human review.

title: Sr Buyer/Planner
description:
Who We Are

At nLIGHT, we are constantly extending the cutting-edge of laser technology in multiple dynamic and growing markets. We are a leading provider of high-power semiconductors and fiber lasers for industrial, microfabrication, and aerospace & defense applications, to name a few. Our lasers are changing not only the way things are made, but also changing the things that can be made.

Headquartered in Camas, Washington, nLIGHT is a publicly listed company (NASDAQ: LASR).

Job Summary

The Senior Buyer/Planner is the functional expert responsible for end-to-end production planning and purchasing for complex, high impact product lines. This role translates demand into executable, compliant, and stable production and material plans while owning delivery, cost, risk, and supplier outcomes. The Senior Buyer/Planner solves systemic planning, scheduling, and material issues; defines and governs planning standards; mentors and develops junior Buyer/Planners; and drives continuous improvement across planning, purchasing, and ERP disciplines. Success in this role is defined by sustained operational stability, strategic supplier performance, strong cross functional influence, and measurable improvement in planning maturity and resilience.

Key Responsibilities
• Optimize production flow by identifying bottlenecks, proposing load leveling strategies, and balancing capacity, material availability, and demand volatility
• Lead root cause analysis and corrective actions for chronic shortages, Work Order failures, capacity constraints, and systemic execution issues
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on planning accuracy, lead time reduction, data integrity, and schedule stability
• Support NPI item tracking and ensure planning and purchasing readiness for new product introductions
• Train and mentor Associate Buyer/Planner and Buyer/Planner I/II team members on D365, Work Order discipline, and planning and purchasing methodologies
• Participate in planning optimization initiatives and advanced D365 tooling to improve scalability and decision quality
• Monitor supplier and subcontractor contract performance to ensure compliance with contractual obligations
• Ensure compliance with Federal Acquisition Regulations, DFARS, and Cost Accounting Standards (FAR, DFARS, CAS)
• Support price and cost analysis of subcontractor proposals, ensuring alignment with sector policies and regulatory requirements
• Support audits, customer engagements, and compliance driven planning and purchasing activities
• Lead supplier and part qualification initiatives to support resiliency, scalability, and compliance
• Lead supplier negotiations and cost reduction initiatives, balancing cost, quality, delivery, and risk
• Own planning and purchasing standards, work instructions, and governance models, including Work Order policies, frozen fences, and BOM release rules
• Partner with Engineering to govern BOM accuracy, release readiness, and configuration discipline
• Partner with Operations and Engineering leadership to define and drive planning strategy
• Lead planning and purchasing integration into S&OP, ensuring alignment across forecast, capacity, inventory, and material strategies
• Own end to end production planning and purchasing for complex product lines, ensuring demand is translated into stable, executable, and compliant plans
• Ensure consistent application of planning discipline across teams and programs
• Own supplier related risk identification and mitigation strategies for assigned product lines
• Serve as a subject matter expert and escalation point for complex planning, material, and supplier issues.
• Influence cross functional decision making through clear, data driven communication and leadership presence

Qualifications
• 6+ years of experience in planning and purchasing, supply chain management, or manufacturing operations; prior Buyer/Planner or production leadership experience strongly preferred.
• Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, engineering, or a related field preferred, or equivalent practical experience
• Deep planning and purchasing expertise with the ability to anticipate downstream impacts of changes across the supply chain
• Exceptional cross functional communication and influence skills
• Advanced proficiency in ERP systems, including D365 (filters, exception management, analysis, and optimization)
• Proven ability to manage dynamic build plans, rapid prioritization, and urgent escalations in a high stakes environment
• Advanced analytical capability, including expert use of Excel for data analysis and decision support

Preferred Experience
• Experience supporting Department of Defense (DoD), aerospace, or government-funded programs.
• Working knowledge of Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR), Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS), Cost Accounting Standards (CAS), and subcontract compliance requirements.
• Experience performing price analysis, price reasonableness determinations, and supplier proposal evaluations.
• Familiarity with supplier source selection processes, competitive bid evaluations, and sole-source justification documentation.
• Experience supporting supplier flow downs for contractual, quality, cybersecurity, export control, and regulatory requirements.
• Exposure to Contractor Purchasing System Reviews (CPSR), Defense Contract Management Agency (DCMA), Defense Contract Audit Agency (DCAA), customer audits, or other regulatory reviews.
• Experience working within AS9100, ISO 9001, or other regulated manufacturing environments.
• Knowledge of counterfeit parts prevention, supply chain assurance, supplier risk management, and supply chain resiliency practices.
• Familiarity with government property, customer-furnished property, and material traceability requirements.
• Experience supporting proposal activities, fact-finding efforts, Requests for Information (RFIs), and compliance-driven procurement activities.
• Experience leading supplier qualification, supplier development, and supplier performance improvement initiatives.
• Experience negotiating long-term supplier agreements, strategic sourcing initiatives, and cost reduction programs.
• Familiarity with International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and Export Administration Regulations (EAR)

title: Data Engineer (Databricks)
description:
The Data Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable and reliable data pipelines on Databricks and cloud platforms. The role requires integrating diverse data sources, ensuring high-quality data processing, and supporting analytics, reporting, and machine learning workloads. The role involves collaborating closely with analytics, product, and infrastructure teams to enhance the company’s data platform while adhering to best practices for governance, monitoring, and reliability.

What will you do?

  • Develop and maintain ETL pipelines for centralized data storage systems (e.g. Delta Lake).
  • Integrate data from databases, APIs, log files, streaming platforms, and external providers
  • Develop data transformation routines to clean, normalize, and aggregate data
  • Apply data processing techniques to handle complex or inconsistent datasets
  • Contribute to frameworks and best practices for code development and deployment
  • Implement data governance in alignment with company standards
  • Partner with analytics and product leaders to design and operationalize pipelines
  • Collaborate with infrastructure leaders to advance cloud-based data platforms
  • Explore new tools and techniques leveraging Azure, Databricks, or related platforms
  • Monitor data pipelines to detect and resolve issues promptly
  • Develop monitoring tools, alerts, and automated error-handling mechanisms
  • Analyse business requirements and identify data extraction requirements
  • Attend requirement grooming and refinement sessions with users
  • Develop and maintain ETL pipelines for ingestion, transformation, validation, and loading
  • Optimise performance and batch scheduling
  • Develop dashboards, reports, scorecards, and data visualizations
  • Perform SIT, data validation, data profiling and confirm data accuracy
  • Validate completeness and consistency of ETL Loads
  • Support UAT and production implementation

The ideal candidate should possess:

title: Quality Control Inspector
description:
Job Overview

Legacy Supply Chain is hiring a Quality Control Inspector to support our new distribution center located in Greenfield, IN. As a Quality Control Inspector, you will be responsible for inspecting and measuring automotive parts to ensure compliance with quality specifications outlined in engineering drawings. The Quality Control Inspector will utilize a variety of precision measurement tools to accurately document inspection results and generate detailed problem statements for any non-conforming products. This position includes a comprehensive benefits package including 401(k) plan with up to 5% company match!

Schedule and Compensation

  • Monday through Friday - 3:30pm to 12:00am
  • Starting pay rate $31.00 per hour
  • Paid weekly

Job Details

What to expect as a Quality Control Inspector:

  • Inspect and validate parts with precision tools (calipers, micrometers, etc.) to ensure strict adherence to engineering specifications, driving fast, high-quality production outcomes.
  • Document and track inspection results in the Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring accurate and accessible data for cross-functional teams (Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and management) to make informed, timely decisions.
  • Identify and record Non-Conformances with clear, actionable detail, enabling efficient Non-Conformance Report (NCR) generation and swift corrective action with suppliers.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to communicate inspection results and ensure timely transfer of products to appropriate stages of production, minimizing delays and ensuring continuous workflow.
  • Adhere to safety standards and procedures to maintain a safe, compliant work environment, mitigating risks and ensuring the well-being of the team.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and quality investigations, driving operational efficiency, identifying root causes, and implementing corrective actions to maintain high-quality standards.
  • Proactively seek opportunities to streamline work processes, improve efficiency, and enhance quality, fostering a culture of innovation and operational excellence.
  • Support all Quality departments as needed, providing expertise and assistance to ensure seamless and effective quality assurance across functions.
  • Assist with Packaging Quality Inspections when required, ensuring that all products meet the highest standards before shipment.
  • Perform other duties as assigned, demonstrating flexibility and a results-oriented approach to meet the evolving needs of the organization.

Qualifications:

  • Strong attention to detail with a high focus on accuracy and accountability.
  • Ability to read and interpret part blueprints and engineering drawings.
  • Experience using a Quality Management System (QMS) to complete quality inspections (Intelex will be the system used).
  • Ability to operate precision measurement tools, including rulers, calipers, torque wrenches, thread gauges, wrenches, grease guns, and vise grips.
  • Primary material handling equipment (MHE) used will be carts and pallet jacks.
  • Must be able to safely lift and manipulate products weighing up to 50 lbs.
  • A technical or automotive background is strongly preferred, as the 13-Point Inspection process evaluates the fit, form, and function of automotive parts.
  • Initial training will take place in Canada and is expected to last approximately 2–3 weeks. Candidates will need a valid passport for travel.

Why Legacy Supply Chain?

  • Competitive Pay: Highly competitive wages
  • Retirement Support: Company-funded 401(k) with top match percentage in the industry
  • Robust Health Plan: Affordable, comprehensive protection for you and your family - medical, dental, vision, and more
  • Job Skills Development: On-the-job supply chain skills development, in person and online training
  • Leadership Development: Programs to prepare future supply chain leaders including new manager training and Leadership Excellence Summit
  • Career Opportunities: Build a career path at a growing company that focuses on development, succession planning, and HIPO identification

About Legacy Supply Chain

For over 40 years, Legacy Supply Chain has grown and evolved as a pioneering, mid-sized 3PL provider that businesses depend on to create control over their dynamic omni-channel supply chains. We believe in the power of a more connected world and staying connected to our employees, our customers and their consumers is more important than ever.

We take an intentional approach to creating alignment between our people, our culture, and our values. Our proven development methodology ensures that our 6 core values guide our business strategy and our daily behaviors.

Our purpose is to develop servant leaders who help people, commerce and communities work better together. Because when people lead by example and serve one another, everyone profits – and that certainly feels like a Legacy worth leaving.

title: Entrepreneur in Residence - Travel & Hotels
description:
Always Friday is the first AI-native agency. We are not an event agency: we are the startup that will make the agency model, as it exists today, obsolete. We are a corporate event concierge built on a proprietary platform: companies use us to book venues, catering, transportation and team-building activities for everything from a business dinner to a seminar to a large annual retreat. Behind the scenes, AI and automation take care of every administrative and low-value task, so that our Event Specialists spend their time on the only thing that cannot be automated: the client.

We were born a year and a half ago and we are moving fast. We closed a pre-seed round with top-tier VCs, revenue is growing 7x year over year, and 22 exceptionally talented people already work at Always Friday. We are closing 2026 in strong growth and opening two new markets in 2027: Spain and the United Kingdom.

The corporate events space is ripe for disruption. Companies keep increasing their event budgets, yet the industry still runs on outdated concierge models and software that hasn't evolved in decades. Always Friday is redefining that landscape: automation that streamlines planning end to end, a better experience for organisers and attendees, and financial transparency and compliance built in by default. We are not just making event management easier. We are setting a new standard for the industry.

Our supply, the network of hotels, estates, venues and vendors that powers the platform, is today our most under-used asset. A few months ago it also became a customer acquisition channel: through Bridge Referral, partner venues forward us the corporate event requests they cannot serve, and we turn them into events. Bridge is already live, has already closed its first events, and activates dozens of new venues every month with no sales effort. What is missing is the person who turns it into a machine.

The mission, with numbers. You have twelve months to make Always Friday's supply our number one customer acquisition channel throughout Europe. You report directly to the CEO and lead the supply team, one person today, growing with results.

Tasks

You will own the journey from 0 → 1 → scale.

At the beginning, there will be no large team, no perfect playbook and no ready-made answers. You will have hypotheses, early traction, access to thousands of potential partners and the resources of Always Friday behind you. Everything else is yours to build.

In the first 90 days

Your priority is traction.

  • Take us as much clients as possible through that channel, from month 1. Revenue generated from your channel will be North Star Metric for this role.
  • Test different pitches, incentives, onboarding flows and activation strategies.
  • Own the funnel end to end: partner acquisition, activation, lead generation, qualification and revenue.
  • Personally call and visit venues to build the Bridge activation and engagement playbook: who to call, what to say, how to get the first lead within 30 days of activation.
  • Define the partner venue ICP (today we have hypotheses and early data, not certainties) and turn it into prospecting lists and prioritisation criteria.

After the 90 days

  • Build the first repeatable playbook for taking a venue from prospect → partner → first lead → first closed event.
  • Hire and lead the first people dedicated to the channel.
  • Define targets, incentives, pipeline reviews and operating cadence.
  • Build framework partnerships with hotel groups, chains and other hospitality networks.
  • Build venue acquisition channels beyond our existing base: regional consortia and DMOs, industry listings, venue-to-venue referrals, trade events.
  • Take the model you built in Italy to Spain and the UK, working with the local country managers.
  • Own the supply numbers in front of the CEO and investors: active partners, leads, revenue generated, acquisition cost.

Requirements

Must have

  • 2+ years of experience in startups, scale-ups, consulting, business development or similarly high-ownership environments.
  • Strong Sales & GTM skills. You are comfortable with cold calls, outreach, demos, negotiations and closing.
  • A track record of taking something from 0 to 1: a new market, product, acquisition channel, business line or commercial initiative.
  • Strong analytical thinking. You understand funnels, conversion rates, CAC and unit economics and use numbers to decide what to do next.
  • You don’t have problems in getting your hands dirty: this role might lead to create a huge team but, at first, it will mean cold calling family run “agriturismi” to ask for their opinion on phone. Are you willing to do this? Are you motivated enough?
  • How to scale a channel from the ground up

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience both acquiring independent venues (by phone and on site) and negotiating with groups and chains at head-office level.
  • You have worked in a startup or scale-up in a growth phase and know what it means to change the process every month.
  • You know MICE: you know what a brief, a site inspection and an agency commission are.
  • You use AI in your daily work and want to work in a company that puts it at the centre of every process.

This is not for you if

  • You want to manage an existing machine rather than build one.
  • You expect someone else to define the strategy before you execute it.
  • You prefer planning to testing.
  • You are uncomfortable picking up the phone yourself.
  • You need a large team before you can produce results.

Benefits

  • RAL OTE €70,000 - €100,000 uncapped
  • Equity: we are still an early-stage startup and equity taken now can be worth A LOT in just a couple years.
  • Benefits: Lunch Vouchers and Private Insurance Plan. This offer will grow as much as we grow as a company.
  • Dinner Voucher for nights in the office
  • You will work in of the hottest, fastest growing startup in Europe.
  • 80 days where you can work remotely from wherever you want
  • A cool office in the city center in Milan
  • Team life you'll actually enjoy: from Friday drinks and team sports to offsites, seminars, and parties. Life at AF is full of moments to connect, unwind, and celebrate together.
  • An AI-native company: every process, from prospecting to reporting, is built with AI tools. We don't use them to replace commercial work, we use them to remove everything that isn't relationship.

title: B-korts chaufför till växande återvinningsbolag
description:
Vi på Avfallskonsulten i Huvudstaden AB växer snabbt och söker nu en B-korts chaufför som vill bli en del av ett engagerat, hårt arbetande team – där vi ställer upp för varandra och samtidigt har roligt på jobbet.

Det här är en tjänst för dig som tar ansvar, gillar att arbeta självständigt men samtidigt trivs i ett lag där alla bidrar. Vi är inne i en expansiv fas och söker dig som vill vara med på resan.

Du behöver inte ha erfarenhet från återvinningsbranschen sedan tidigare. Har du arbetat med distribution, budbil eller annan transportkörning är det meriterande – men rätt inställning väger tyngst.

Om oss

Avfallskonsulten i Huvudstaden AB är ett ungt och hungrigt företag som utmanar de stora aktörerna i avfalls- och återvinningsbranschen. Sedan starten 2019 har vi haft ett tydligt mål: att skapa smartare, effektivare och mer kundnära lösningar inom avfallshantering.

Vi utgår från Älta/Tyresö i Stockholm där vi har lager, kontor och fordon samlade på samma plats. Beslutsvägarna är korta, tempot är högt och vi bygger företaget tillsammans. Här är man inte en i mängden – här är man en viktig del av helheten.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som B-korts chaufför hos oss kommer du bland annat att:

  • Köra lätt lastbil för insamling av återvinning och avfall hos våra kunder
  • Arbeta med hämtning av exempelvis förpackningar, grovavfall och annat material
  • Transportera material till olika avfalls- och återvinningsanläggningar
  • Ha daglig kundkontakt och representera företaget ute på uppdrag
  • Bidra till struktur, kvalitet och effektivitet i det dagliga arbetet

Arbetet är varierande och praktiskt, med både körning och fysiska moment. Ingen dag är den andra lik.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som:

  • Har B-körkort
  • Är ansvarstagande, punktlig och har en stark arbetsmoral
  • Trivs med fysiskt arbete och har god fysik
  • Gillar att arbeta både självständigt och i team
  • Har ett professionellt och serviceinriktat bemötande

Hos oss är attityden viktig. Vi jobbar hårt – men vi har också kul tillsammans. Rätt person kommer att passa in i ett sammansvetsat team där man hjälper varandra och driver arbetet framåt.

Vi erbjuder

  • En trygg anställning i ett stabilt och växande företag
  • Lön enligt kollektivavtal
  • Möjlighet att utvecklas i takt med att företaget växer
  • Nära samarbete med kollegor och ledning
  • En arbetsplats med högt tempo, tydligt ansvar och stark laganda

Låter detta som något för dig?

Skicka in din ansökan – vi ser fram emot att höra från dig och kanske välkomna dig till vårt team 🚛♻️

title: Sr Security Engineer - 11917
description:
Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.

Why join Coupa?

  • Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
  • Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.
  • Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.
Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.

The Impact of a Lead Security Engineer at Coupa:

Coupa's Security Engineering team protects our enterprise, product, platform, and customer data at scale. As Lead Security Engineer, you will be a hands-on technical leader on the Security Engineering team — architecting and building cloud security controls, setting engineering standards, and partnering closely with Engineering, IT, and Compliance to ship durable, automated security tooling rather than one-off fixes. You thrive on ambiguity, sweat the implementation details, and take pride in solutions that scale across hundreds of accounts and services.

What You’ll Do

    • Architect and build multi cloud security controls across Coupa's cloud environment. VPC segmentation, security groups/NACLs, IAM policy design using least-privilege and permission boundaries, and Organizations/SCPs for guardrails at scale.
    • Build policy-as-code and IaC security guardrails and wire them into CI/CD as pre-merge and pre-deploy gates rather than after the fact reviews.
    • Harden containerized workloads - image scanning, admission control, pod security standards, and runtime detection.
    • Write auto-remediation for cloud misconfiguration and drift so common findings close without manual ticket routing.
    • Own Vulnerability management program, act as the technical escalation point for security incidents and vulnerability findings - leading forensics, containment, and root-cause analysis using cloud-native and EDR tooling, and driving remediation to closure.
    • Partner with Risk & Compliance to translate audit framework requirements (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, FedRAMP) into concrete technical controls, and automate evidence collection by integrating cloud telemetry with GRC tooling.
    • Mentor other security engineers through design review, threat modeling, and code/architecture review; raise the technical bar for the whole team.
    • Own reference architectures, threat models, and runbooks for the security tooling you build; participate in and help improve the on-call rotation.

What You Will Bring to Coupa

    • 10+ years of security engineering experience, including significant hands-on work securing production cloud environments at scale, plus experience leading projects or mentoring other engineers.
    • Deep, hands-on AWS security expertise - IAM, VPC/networking, KMS, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Config, and Organizations/SCPs; working knowledge of GCP or Azure security is a plus.
    • Production experience with Terraform (or equivalent IaC) and policy-as-code frameworks, plus container/Kubernetes security tooling.
    • Strong software engineering fundamentals - Python and/or Go, Git-based workflows, and building/maintaining CI/CD security integrations (SAST, DAST, SCA).
    • Experience with SIEM/SOAR platforms and vulnerability management tooling (e.g., Wiz, Qualys, Tenable) - building detections and workflows, not just consuming dashboards.
    • Working knowledge of compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, FedRAMP, NIST 800-53) sufficient to translate control requirements into engineering work.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills - able to write clear technical design docs and explain risk trade-offs to auditors and engineering leadership alike.
    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
    • Relevant certifications a plus: CISSP, CCSP, CISA, or AWS/GCP security certifications.
    • Some international travel may be required.
The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

  • Referral Bonus Program: Share the Coupa experience! Receive generous monetary referral bonuses when you successfully refer talented friends or acquaintances who are hired into open roles .
Please note: In addition to these global well-being perks, Coupa offers highly competitive, location-specific benefits packages (which include comprehensive medical/dental insurance, retirement/pension plans, and life or accident protection) tailored to your primary work location. Your recruiter will walk you through the specific regional benefits package for this role during the interview process.

title: Credentialing Specialist
description:
Job Purpose: As a Credentialing Specialist at Denova Collaborative Health, you will play a key role in supporting provider readiness, compliance, and operational success by ensuring providers, clinicians, facilities, and payer records are properly credentialed and maintained. This role helps ensure our teams can continue delivering quality, integrated care while meeting payer, licensing, regulatory, and accreditation requirements.

This is an non-exempt position reporting to the Credentialing Supervisor.

What You Will Do:

  • Prepare, submit, and track credentialing and re-credentialing applications for providers, clinicians, facilities, private payers, managed care organizations, and other applicable entities.
  • Support credentialing processes for physicians, nurse practitioners, physician assistants, clinical therapists, and other healthcare professionals.

description:

Kleinfelder, a Forbes' Top Employer for Engineers in North America, is committed to a people-first culture, technical excellence, and creating opportunities where employees can thrive!

Successful candidates will thrive in a dynamic environment where innovation, professionalism, and respect for cultural resources are highly valued.

quality.• Contributes technical expertise to the preparation of project proposals and research plans, providing insight into field operations, logistics, and methodologies for the successful execution of archaeological projects.

Bachelor's degree in Archaeology/Anthropology or related field.5+ years of archaeological survey and CRM experience.Demonstrated experience leading archaeological field crews.Knowledge of Section 106 and cultural resource compliance requirements.Experience preparing and reviewing archaeological technical reports and field documentation.

description:
Company Description

About Walden University Walden University, a Covista institution, supports a diverse community of adult learners from across the U.S. and other countries, who seek to achieve their academic goals and make positive, lasting social impact in their professions and communities. Walden offers more than 100 online degree and certificate programs, for students pursuing a bachelor’s, master’s, doctoral or certificate. Walden University has graduated more than 174,000 students and is accredited by the Higher Learning Commission.

Visit WaldenU.edu for more information, and follow on Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn.

Walden University is a pioneer in student-centered distance education. An accredited graduate institution with a mission for social change, Walden is dedicated to high academic standards and helping students make a difference in their professions, organizations, and communities. Walden University offers advanced degrees online to professionals whose work impacts others.

Walden's Ph.D. in Management, DBA, MBA, and BSBA degree programs are accredited by the Accreditation Council for Business Schools and Programs (ACBSP), a leading specialized accreditation association that identifies and supports excellence in business education.

Job Description

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Doctor of Business Administration (DBA) Adjunct faculty members’ primary responsibility will be teaching and mentoring capstone students. Faculty must demonstrate a commitment to actively support the learning and development needs of students earning their degrees in a distance learning environment.

Walden faculty must have a commitment to fostering Walden’s Community of Care.

  • Student-centered engagement and support — Faculty are expected to communicate regularly, provide timely guidance, support students individually, and connect them with appropriate resources.
  • Academic expertise and quality feedback — Faculty should demonstrate strong knowledge of university systems, policies, research processes, rubrics, and program expectations while giving constructive, detailed feedback.
  • Empathy balanced with accountability — Faculty should meet students where they are, show flexibility when appropriate, and still uphold academic standards that support timely, high-quality doctoral completion.

Based on student enrollment, Adjunct Faculty may be invited to instruct content courses or research methodology courses, which they are credentialed to teach. Participation in Mentor Training will be provided and required.

Key performance indicators of faculty include:

  • · Embracing diverse, process-learning approaches resulting in outcomes of academic quality and integrity.
  • · Knowledge of an inquiry-action model of education fostering applied research, discovery, and critical thinking that results in curiosity, lifelong learning, and positive contributions to societal wellbeing.
  • · Prioritizing student engagement through weekly substantive, content-based and motivational discussion posts to the classroom.
  • · Building collaborative, collegial, and positive relationships and communications with other faculty members.
  • · Supporting students where they are and as individuals who are balancing challenges at home and work.

Availability

Adjunct faculty should be reasonably accessible to their students. Faculty members are expected to be available to students outside of the online asynchronous course discussion board. In addition to providing substantive feedback on student submissions, faculty members will publish their availability to students through course syllabi, instructor information in the classroom, or other appropriate documents.

Course Capstone Research Mentoring and Teaching

Discussion Boards for classrooms are open 24 hours per day, 7 days per week. Although postings to the classroom may be done at any time of day, postings and responses must be completed in a timely manner in accordance with the Faculty Handbook or other criteria established by Walden University and the program to which they are assigned. As such,

Adjunct Faculty members are expected to be in classrooms for a minimum of 4 days per week and post responses to students’ questions within 48 hours. Faculty Members are required to verify the quality of student submissions, and to provide feedback and grades to students through the online classroom.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE:

  • Terminal degree in Business Administration (PhD, DBA) or a related field from an accredited institution is required.
  • Proof of teaching and mentoring business doctoral students in an online instructional setting at the graduate level for at least 1 year.
  • Demonstrate ongoing engagement in scholarly and professional business activities within the past 5 years and exhibits proficiency in APA 7th edition formatting and citation standards.
  • Strong research methodology background in quantitative and qualitative methods in research (preference given to quantitative). Excellent leadership, communication, team, and human relation skills.

Technology Requirements:

  • Adjunct faculty provide their own laptops and are expected to use the Walden University Learning Management System and the Microsoft 365 tools with their assigned Walden email addresses in their Walden activities. Walden University provides a Walden e-mail account and access to the learning platform, password-protected faculty sections of the website, university and college cloud services, and other faculty communications tools.
  • The Faculty Member must be able to use Microsoft Office products (MS Word, MS Excel, and MS PowerPoint), zip software, and Adobe Acrobat and must have reliable Internet access as well as alternate access in cases where primary access becomes unavailable.

In support of the pay transparency laws enacted across the country, the expected compensation rate for this position is as follows:

  • Graduate Course Instruction: $1,560 - $4,080 per Quarter or Semester, depending on type of course taught and length of course
  • Undergraduate Course Instruction: $700 - $2,200 per quarter, depending on type of course taught and length of course

    Actual pay may be adjusted based on job-related factors permitted by law, such as type of course taught; experience and training; geographic location; licensure and certifications; market factors; departmental budgets; and responsibility. Walden also offers other opportunities for its contributing faculty members, such as dissertation/doctoral study committee chair positions, research reviewing, and dissertation and doctoral study mentoring.

    Our Talent Acquisition Team will be happy to answer any questions you may have, and we look forward to learning more about your salary requirements.

description:
About Us

At Genworth and CareScout, we’re on a mission to simplify and dignify the aging experience.

The truth is, most of us will help a parent, spouse, family member, friend, or neighbor navigate aging and care at some point in our lives. We’ve been there ourselves. That’s why we’re building better ways to help people find, fund, and understand aging care all while being supported every step of the way.

We’re a team of curious problem-solvers, compassionate listeners, and people who care about making a difference. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to fostering an inclusive culture where every team member feels respected, supported, and empowered to bring their authentic self.


Our four values guide our strategy, our decisions, and our interactions:

  • Make it human. We care about the people that make up our customers, colleagues, and communities.
  • Make it about others. We do what's best for our customers and collaborate to drive progress.
  • Make it happen. We work with intention toward a common purpose and forge ways forward together.
  • Make it better. We create fulfilling purpose-driven careers by learning from the world and each other.

POSITION TITLE

Long Term Care Actuary, Controllership Oversight

POSITION LOCATION

Richmond, VA

Remote US (Eastern/Central Time)


This position is available to Virginia residents as Richmond, Virginia in-office applicants or remote applicants residing in states/locations under Eastern or Central Standard Time: Alabama, Arkansas, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Washington DC, Vermont, West Virginia or Wisconsin.

YOUR ROLE

As a member of the Long Term Care (LTC) Actuarial Model Governance and Controllership team, you will serve as a key player in the successful governance and controllership of Genworth’s LTC models and processes. In this role, you will become expert on LTC’s model, data and process flows and provide guidance on the appropriateness and design of controls to ensure that they comply with Company, industry, and actuarial professional standards.


This role requires collaborating closely with your team, control owners, and cross-functional teams to ensure process and control consistency. Your primary focus will be with the valuation and inforce rate action teams, with the expectation that oversight will expand to projections, experience, and data analytics teams. You will be a support the model governance team to complete model peer reviews and provide other analysis as needed.


What you will be doing

  • Oversee the LTC control environment fostering open communication, sound control design and execution consistency across teams
  • Consult on controls for new or enhanced processes
  • Review existing controls for key high-risk processes and make improvement recommendations
  • Collaborate with Operations and IT on administration system and data issues and controls
  • Support efforts to develop clear and effective model and process documentation to increase transparency, accessibility, and understandability
  • Provide governance peer review support for the development and enhancement of LTC actuarial models and processes
  • Work to expand governance and controllership oversight to include emerging teams and products
  • Assist with model change peer reviews and provide guidance on model governance processes.

What you bring

  • BS/BA Degree in mathematics, statistics, actuarial science business/finance, and/or related major
  • Fellow of Society of Actuaries (FSA) designation or Associate (ASA) with commensurate experience
  • 5+ years of relevant actuarial experience, preferably with LTC insurance
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to meet project deadlines and manage multiple priorities
  • Strong communication skills, both oral and written
  • Ability to interact professionally and effectively in a team environment
  • Knowledge of actuarial processes: valuation, projections, and experience
  • Results oriented, accountable for performance, and willingness to take ownership of projects


ADDITIONAL

  • At this time, Genworth will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.

Employee Benefits & Well-Being

Genworth employees make a difference in people’s lives every day. We’re committed to making a difference in our employees’ lives.

  • Competitive Compensation & Total Rewards Incentives
  • Comprehensive Healthcare Coverage
  • Multiple 401(k) Savings Plan Options
  • Auto Enrollment in Employer-Directed Retirement Account Feature (100% employer-funded!)
  • Generous Paid Time Off – Including 12 Paid Holidays, Volunteer Time Off and Paid Family Leave
  • Disability, Life, and Long Term Care Insurance
  • Tuition Reimbursement, Student Loan Repayment and Training & Certification Support
  • Wellness support including gym membership reimbursement and Employee Assistance Program resources (work/life support, financial & legal management)
  • Caregiver and Mental Health Support Services

The Domestic Operations Agent is responsible for coordinating and executing day-to-day domestic freight forwarding operations. This role acts as a key point of contact between customers, carriers, and internal teams, ensuring shipments move accurately and on schedule while maintaining compliance with company standard operating procedures.

Stay ahead

title: Revenue Enablement Lead

Founded in 2010, Semios Group is a leading agricultural technology company helping growers, agronomists, and ag retailers manage over 200 million acres across five countries. Semios pioneered variable-rate pheromone-based mating disruption in orchards and has since expanded into a comprehensive portfolio covering crop protection, water management, frost control, automation, and a leading farm management information system. The Semios Group includes trusted brands such as Semios, Agworld, Altrac, and Greenbook. We continue to drive the next generation of digital agriculture, supporting growers, agronomists and ag retailers in improving sustainability and profitability.

Our innovative work has been recognized with several industry awards, including:

  • AgTech Breakthrough – Smart Irrigation Company & Pest Management Solution of the Year
  • Thrive Top 50
  • Google for Startups Accelerator Cohort
  • Global Cleantech Top 100

We know our journey is only achievable by having a great team who shares ideas, tries new things, and learns as we go.

The Revenue Enablement Lead serves as a strategic, cross-functional leader unifying teams, processes, data, and tools to drive end-to-end operational excellence and revenue growth. In this role, you will ensure commercial teams possess the knowledge, data, and operational resources (processes and technology stack) required to consistently hit business revenue targets.

As a champion for data-driven operational frameworks, you will align go-to-market (GTM) goals, elevate business performance tracking, and establish repeatable revenue processes across the organization. Reporting to the Director, Revenue Enablement, you will partner closely with sales leadership, marketing, product, and finance to build high-impact operations processes & frameworks and continuous enablement programs. This role bridges go-to-market strategy with tactical execution to retain and grow revenue across product portfolios.

You’re driven by purpose and motivated by work that matters. You’re looking for more than a role, you want to be part of a growing, forward-thinking company solving real-world challenges to improve how farming works, today and for the future.

What you will do:

Align Cross-Functional Goals:

  • Unify product, marketing, sales, and customer success teams around a single, cohesive GTM strategy.
  • Partner closely with finance and operations to increase profitability visibility.
  • Collaborate to design and implement sales incentive and compensation programs that drive growth in alignment with company objectives.
  • Partner with sales leadership to track, improve forecasting discipline and strengthen pipeline management practices across the organization.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams, including GTM, Finance, Marketing, Operations to identify and roll out revenue generation programs

Operational Frameworks:

  • Fine-tune existing and define new data-driven, predictable, and repeatable frameworks.
  • Build pricing architecture, governance frameworks and profitability metrics.
  • Map, refine, and optimize internal workflows to enable commercial operational excellence and revenue growth.
  • Evaluate, deploy, and manage enablement tools and CRM integrations to maximize team efficiency, tool adoption, and workflow hygiene.

Commercial Upskilling:

  • Design and execute structured training programs to onboard new commercial hires and upskill existing team members.
  • Organize, manage, and distribute high-impact collateral, playbooks, and templates tailored to every stage of the sales funnel.

Performance Visibility:

  • Enhance business tracking, forecasting, and reporting accuracy.
  • Define and measure key performance indicators (KPIs) to provide visibility into sales efficiency and overall revenue health.
  • Build transparent models for pipeline tracking, revenue forecasting, and renewal management.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Operations, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years in sales operations, revenue enablement, revenue operations, sales & marketing strategy, go-to-market operations, pricing, preferably in an ag-tech, agriculture or technology B2B environments.
  • Experience defining and executing end-to-end sales operations frameworks, revenue growth programs, CRM enhancements, forecasting optimization.
  • Experience building performance dashboards and delivering reporting capabilities

Skills

  • Deep proficiency in CRM ecosystems (Salesforce preferred) and sales operations tools (Quip, PandaDoc, Zapier, Tableau)
  • Understanding of SaaS monetization models or subscription-based product portfolios.
  • Effective facilitator and communicator with proven ability to coach and collaborate across departments.
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and capable of managing multiple training and content workstreams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Comfortable managing multiple ongoing administrative tasks while balancing longer-term project deliverables.
  • High attention to detail, particularly regarding data hygiene and documentation formatting and accuracy.

title: Culinary Supervisor
description:
JOB SUMMARY

Under general direction, the Culinary Supervisor serves as a hands-on leader, actively engaged in daily kitchen operations while overseeing and supporting the culinary team. This role requires working scheduled shifts on the line, preparing and cooking alongside team members to ensure quality, consistency, and adherence to brand standards. The Culinary Supervisor leads by example, fosters team development, and contributes to a well-organized, efficient, and high-performing kitchen environment.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

  • Actively work scheduled shifts on the line, preparing, cooking, and plating food in accordance with hotel standards
  • Supervise and support daily kitchen operations while working side-by-side with culinary team members
  • Lead, coach, and motivate line cooks and kitchen staff during service
  • Ensure all food is prepared and presented according to hotel and brand standards
  • Maintain strict compliance with all health, safety, and sanitation standards, including local and state regulations
  • Assist with training and onboarding of new culinary team members through hands-on guidance
  • Monitor food quality and consistency during service, ensuring all items meet expectations before leaving the kitchen
  • Support inventory management, including ordering, receiving, and proper storage of food products
  • Participate in inventory counts and ensure accurate tracking of supplies
  • Minimize waste and support cost control initiatives
  • Ensure proper labeling, dating, and rotation of food items (FIFO)
  • Communicate effectively with front-of-house teams to ensure smooth and timely service
  • Assist with scheduling and shift coverage as needed
  • Address and resolve team member or operational issues in a timely and professional manner
  • Regular, reliable attendance and punctuality is a key component of this position.
  • Maintains a professional appearance in accordance with Company standards; wears the appropriate uniform or attire.
  • Maintains open and effective communication with team members and management.
  • Attends and participates in team meetings.
  • Adheres to established safety and emergency procedures and protocols, this includes Company, federal, and state specific regulations and guidelines.
  • Completes all required Company training/compliance courses as assigned.
  • Adheres to Company standards and maintains compliance with all policies and procedures.
  • Performs other related duties and responsibilities as assigned.

EDUCATION

  • High school diploma or equivalent.

EXPERIENCE

  • A minimum two (2) years of experience in related field required.
  • A minimum one (1) year of supervisory experience in related field required.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

Oversees and coordinates the department's activities, with a focus on supervisory and organizational goals. While a portion of the time may involve performing tasks similar to those of direct reports, the primary responsibilities are related to management and coordination. Analyzes and resolves issues, establishes work methods, ensures regulatory compliance, and maintains productivity. Uses judgment within established procedures and policies to make appropriate decisions and take necessary actions.

Specific supervisory duties include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Establishes objectives and goals for the team.
  • Assigns, monitors, and reviews work; evaluates direct report's performance.
  • Recruits and interviews.
  • Orientates and trains.
  • Investigates and resolves concerns and complaints.
  • Ensures compliance with safety regulations.
  • Ensures accurate and efficient management of inventory.

LICENSES & CERTIFICATIONS

  • Food Handler's Card - must be state/county-specific.

SKILLS & ABILITIES

This position requires the capability to understand and follow both oral and written directions, as well as the ability to communicate effectively with others in English and interact successfully with internal and external customers.

  • Proficient in time management; the ability to effectively organize and manage multiple priorities.
  • Recognizes an emergency situation and takes appropriate action.
  • Emotional intelligence and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong working relationships with team members at all levels.
  • Skilled in building and motivating a team, fostering a collaborative environment and inspiring high performance.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong focus on accuracy and precision.
  • Ability to work scheduled shifts, follow all timekeeping policies, and comply with federal, state, and local labor regulations, including those related to meal and rest breaks
  • Performs well with frequent interruptions and/or distractions.
  • Able to communicate appropriately and effectively with all levels of management and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to effectively listen, understand, and resolve challenges and concerns from management, team members, and/or customers (internal/external).
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills to include coaching, counseling, and mentoring.
  • Able to identify and seize revenue-generating opportunities while effectively managing costs and resources.
  • Knowledge of key industry trends, best practices, regulations, and the current industry landscape.
  • Basic math skills.
  • Basic knowledge of Google Docs/Microsoft Word.
  • Basic knowledge of Google Sheets/Microsoft Excel.
  • Basic knowledge of Google Slides/Microsoft PowerPoint.
  • Basic knowledge of Gmail/Microsoft Outlook.
  • Ability to adjust effectively to evolving work environments and shifting customer (internal/external) requirements.
  • Able to maintain a positive and professional working environment.
  • Fosters a culture of excellence.
  • Able to work effectively in a culturally diverse environment and support diversity and inclusion within the organization.

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS

  • No travel required.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • Climbing: Ascending or descending ladders, stairs, scaffolding, ramps, poles and the like, using feet and legs and/or hands and arms. Specifically, when the amount of climbing exceeds that needed for ordinary motion.
  • Balancing: Maintaining body equilibrium to prevent falling and walking, standing or crouching on narrow, slippery, or erratically moving surfaces. Specifically, when the amount of balancing exceeds that needed for ordinary motion and maintenance of body equilibrium.
  • Stooping: Bending body downward and forward by bending spine at the waist. Specifically, if it is to a considerable degree and requires full motion of the lower extremities and back muscles.
  • Kneeling: Bending legs at knee to come to a rest on knee or knees.
  • Crouching: Bending the body downward and forward by bending leg and spine.
  • Crawling: Moving about on hands and knees or hands and feet.
  • Reaching: Extending hand(s) and arm(s) in any direction.
  • Standing: Particularly for sustained periods of time.
  • Walking: Moving about on foot to accomplish tasks. Specifically, for long distances or moving from one work site to another often.
  • Pushing: Using upper extremities to press against something with steady force in order to thrust forward, downward, or outward.
  • Pulling: Using upper extremities to exert force in order to draw, haul, or tug objects in a sustained motion.
  • Lifting: Raising objects from a lower to a higher position or moving objects horizontally from position-to-position. Specifically, if it occurs to a considerable degree and requires substantial use of upper extremities and back muscles.
  • Grasping: Applying pressure to an object with the fingers and palm.
  • Feeling: Perceiving attributes of objects, such as size, shape, temperature or texture by touching with skin, particularly that of fingertips.
  • Talking: Expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word. Those activities in which they must convey detailed or important spoken instructions to other workers accurately, loudly, or quickly.
  • Hearing: Perceiving the nature of sounds at normal speaking levels with or without correction. Ability to receive detailed information through oral communication and to make the discriminations in sound.
  • Hands to Fingers: Picking, pinching, typing, or otherwise working, primarily with fingers rather than with the whole hand as in handling.
  • Repetitive Motion: Substantial movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
  • Close Vision: Clear vision at 20 inches or less. Required to perform an activity such as preparing and analyzing data, transcribing, viewing a computer terminal, extensive reading or visual inspections.
  • Distance Vision: Clear vision at 20 feet or more. Required to perform an activity where the seeing job is arm's reach or beyond.
  • Color Vision: Ability to identify and distinguish colors.
  • Peripheral Vision: Ability to observe an area that can be seen up and down or to the left and right while eyes are fixed on a given point.
  • Depth Perception: Ability to judge distances and spatial relationships (three-dimensional).
  • Focus Ability: Ability to adjust the eye to bring an object into sharp focus.
  • Medium Work: Work that requires constant walking or standing and involves regular lifting or moving of items weighing up to 25 pounds and occasional lifting or moving of objects weighing up to 50 pounds. The role may include frequent bending, reaching, or carrying throughout the workday.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Excessive Noise: Exposure to sufficient noise (caused by machines, music, voices, etc.) that warrants shouting in order to be heard above ambient noise level.
  • Vibrations: Exposure to oscillating movements of the extremities or whole body.
  • General Hazards: Exposure to a variety of physically hazardous conditions, such as proximity to moving mechanical parts, moving vehicles, electrical current, working with explosives, on scaffolding, and/or high places.
  • Biological Hazards: Exposure to pathogens caused by working with blood and/or bodily fluids as in the case of first responders or those responsible for disposing of blood-borne pathogens.
  • Chemicals: Exposure to toxic or caustic chemicals (solid, liquid, or gas) which could affect the respiratory system or skin.
  • Atmospheric: Exposure to fumes, odors, dust, mists, gases, or poor ventilation which could affect the respiratory system.

DISCLAIMER

This job description provides a general overview of the work performed, including the typical responsibilities and level of duties associated with this position. It should not be construed as an exhaustive list of tasks or obligations for any individual team member. This description does not alter the employment relationship between the Company and its team members.

The Essential Job Functions, Physical Requirements, and Work Environment characteristics outlined are intended to reflect the requirements needed to perform the essential functions of this role effectively. Management retains the authority to modify, adjust, or revoke job duties and responsibilities as needed, and to make reasonable accommodations to enable qualified team members to fulfill the essential functions of their roles.

The Company is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and is committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions are made based on merit, qualifications, and business needs without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status/characteristic in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
