title: IT Support & Logistics Specialist
description:
Proper AI is an AI-first accounting service built for property managers and real estate operators.

By combining automation, technology, and a global team of accounting experts, we deliver faster, more accurate financial operations at scale.

We are looking for an IT Support & Logistics Specialist to support our growing, geographically distributed team by combining hands-on IT support with IT asset and logistics coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of IT operations, employee support, and equipment management. The individual will be responsible for preparing and configuring devices for new joiners, coordinating IT onboarding and offboarding, maintaining accurate inventories of equipment and peripherals, and managing shipments, returns, and communications with external vendors and shipping companies.

The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, service-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple operational tasks independently. They should have a solid foundation in IT support, experience troubleshooting common hardware and software issues, and the ability to communicate in English at a B1+ level. This is a fully remote position based in Mexico.

Key Responsibilities

    Core Functional Responsibilities

    • Coordinate IT onboarding for new employees, ensuring laptops, peripherals, and other required equipment are prepared and delivered on time.

    • Configure, prepare, and test employee devices according to internal IT standards and established procedures.

    • Coordinate IT offboarding activities, including systems shut down, device recovery, shipping labels, equipment collection, and return tracking.

    • Maintain accurate inventories of laptops, monitors, keyboards, mouse, adapters, and other IT equipment and peripherals.

    • Track equipment assignments, serial numbers, delivery status, employee ownership, location, and lifecycle status.

    • Coordinate shipments, deliveries, collections, and returns with local and international shipping providers, as applicable.

    • Communicate with vendors and logistics companies to resolve delivery issues, arrange collections, and follow up on pending shipments.

    • Provide first-line technical support for common Windows and macOS issues, applications, peripherals, and employee IT requests.

    • Troubleshoot basic hardware, software, connectivity, and account-access issues, escalating complex incidents when necessary.

    • Keep employees informed about the status of support requests, equipment deliveries, and outstanding issues.

    • Maintain clear documentation of IT asset movements, shipment records, onboarding/offboarding checklists, and support procedures.

    • Ensure equipment is handled, stored, shipped, and returned according to company policies.

    • Identify opportunities to improve inventory accuracy, equipment lifecycle management, and operational efficiency.

    • Collaborate with People Operations to align equipment preparation and recovery with employee start dates and departure dates.

    • Support the IT team with administrative and operational tasks related to device management, software deployment, and IT service delivery.

    • When not working on logistics-related tasks, actively assist in resolving IT support tickets, ensuring timely responses, effective solutions, and appropriate escalation when needed.

      • IT Operations and Process Improvement

      • Follow established IT processes and service standards, ensuring requests are tracked and completed within agreed timelines.

      • Use available IT management tools, asset inventories, ticketing systems, and device management platforms to maintain accurate records.

      • Identify recurring operational issues and recommend practical improvements.

      • Create and maintain documentation, checklists, and standard operating procedures for equipment logistics and IT support.

      • Proactively flag missing equipment, delayed shipments, inventory discrepancies, and potential onboarding or offboarding risks.

      • Support the implementation of improvements and automations to IT asset tracking and employee support workflows.

        • Performance and Metrics Tracking

        • Employees have the equipment and IT support they need to work effectively from day one.

        • Maintain accurate and up-to-date IT asset inventory records.

        • Track the timely preparation and delivery of equipment for new joiners.

        • Monitor equipment recovery and return completion rates during offboarding.

        • Track shipment status, delivery delays, and unresolved logistics issues.

        • Identify recurring problems and recommend improvements to onboarding, offboarding, and logistics processes.

        • IT support-tickets response times, resolution times, and escalation rates where applicable.

Required Skills

    Hard Skills

    1. IT support fundamentals — at least 1 year of experience in IT support, IT operations, help desk, or a similar role. Comfortable troubleshooting common hardware, software, operating system, and employee IT issues.

    2. IT asset and inventory management — experience tracking company devices, peripherals, assignments, serial numbers, equipment status, and returns.

    3. IT onboarding and offboarding — experience preparing equipment for new employees and coordinating the recovery of company assets from departing employees.

    4. Logistics and vendor coordination — ability to coordinate shipments, collections, deliveries, and returns with shipping providers and external vendors.

    5. Operating system and device support — familiarity with Windows and basic macOS troubleshooting, Google Workspace, identity management, and employee account provisioning, device setup, peripherals, and standard business applications.

    6. Organization and documentation — ability to maintain accurate records, follow checklists, track outstanding requests, and document processes consistently.

    7. Communication skills — professional proficiency in Spanish and at least B1-level English, with the ability to communicate verbally and in writing with international colleagues and external providers.

    8. IT tools and platforms — familiarity with ticketing systems, SaaS applications, remote support tools, and asset management or device management platforms.

    Soft Skills

    • Strong ownership and follow-through. Takes responsibility for equipment, shipments, and support requests from initiation through completion.

title: Paramediciner eller behandler med minimum 3 års erfaring søges til Ambulance Sjælland – Avancerede ressourcer
description:
Er du paramediciner eller behandler der ønsker at videreuddanne dig til paramediciner, og har du lyst til at være en del af de avancerede ressourcer i Region Sjælland, så skal du kigge med her.

Vi har ledige stillinger følgende steder:

  • Nykøbing Falster (lægevagt, ambulance og PIT)
  • Holbæk (Lægevagt, ambulance og PIT)
  • Ringsted/Næstved (Lægevagt, ambulance og ALB)

Region Østdanmark bliver en realitet fra d. 1/1-27, og du har nu mulighed for at blive en del af det og være med til at udvikle den sub-akutte indsats i den nye region.

Vi søger en paramediciner eller behandler til en kombineret stilling på vores akutbil-lægevagt, akutlægebil og ambulance.

Du bliver en del af den udekørende lægevagt, hvor du i nogle tidsrum kører sammen med en læge og den resterende tid løser opgaverne selvstændigt for lægevagten i samarbejde med en lægefaglig driftsleder.

Der er stor fokus på det sub-akutte område, og derfor skal du trives med at arbejde selvstændigt og køre alene ud for at vurdere og visitere patienterne, og hvor du finder den bedste løsning til den enkelte patient. Du vil derudover indgå i det faste beredskab, hvor du kører med på 1-1-2 opgaverne, og du kan bringe dine færdigheder i spil.

Område Avancerede ressourcer

Ambulance Sjælland, Område Avancerede Ressourcer består af flere forskellige baser i henholdsvis, Holbæk, Ringsted, Næstved, Nykøbing Falster.

Området er ledet af Nicolai Bækmand, som glæder sig til – sammen med dig og dine kolleger – at gøre Ambulance Sjælland klar til den nye Region Østdanmark.

Du bliver en del af et team med høj faglighed, hvor der vil være fokus på udvikling, og hvor DU kan være med til at præge fremtiden hos de Avancerede ressourcer.

Stillingen byder på en kombination af vagter på vores lægevagtsenhed, akutlægebil og ambulance.

Det praktiske…

Du skal have autorisation ved ansættelsen.

Du skal kunne fremvise en tilfredsstillende straffeattest og have kørekort C1.

Vi tilbyder brobizz ved minimum deltidsansættelse, hvis du er bosiddende uden for Region Sjælland.

Ansøgningsfrist er d. 12/11-2026.

Vi holder imidlertid løbende ansættelsessamtaler og fylder således også op på ledige pladser løbende, så vent ikke for længe med at ansøge ønskejobbet. Det kan være væk, før du aner.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, så kontakt sektionsleder Nicolai Bækmand på telefon: 5154 6985.

Ansættelsesforhold

Du ansættes som paramediciner eller behandler, og ansættelsen sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst for FOA overenskomst – SOSU-bilag

Natarbejde

Da stillingen kan indebære natarbejde, tilbydes du gratis helbredskontrol før opstart i overensstemmelse med gældende regler.

Hvis du ønsker at gøre brug af tilbuddet, skal du kontakte din nye kommende leder, som vil være behjælpelig med at iværksætte og koordinere forløbet.

Bliv en del af noget større

Præhospitalt Center favner alle regionale ansatte, der arbejder med det præhospitale område. Det inkluderer Befordringsservice; AMK-vagtcentral; Ambulance Sjælland; Kvalitet, Uddannelse og Beredskab; Administrationen; Hjemmebehandling; Logistik og Planlægning; Lægevagten; Vaccinationsindsatsen samt den præhospitale forskningsenhed.

Når du arbejder i Præhospitalt Center, bliver du en del af holdet bag den akutte og præhospitale indsats i Region Sjælland. Her arbejder dispatchere, planlæggere, forskere, behandlere og administrative medarbejdere side om side for at sikre, at hjælpen når frem.

Nogle sidder ved telefoner, andre udvikler løsninger, planlægger ruter eller forsker i bedre behandling. Fælles er, at vi arbejder for, at borgerne får hurtig, tryg og professionel hjælp – hvad enten det handler om akutberedskab, lægevagt, befordring, hjemme-behandling, uddannelse eller nye måder at gøre tingene på.

Du får en hverdag, hvor fagligheder mødes, og hvor din viden bliver brugt. Med ansvar, sparring og kolleger, der hjælper hinanden i mål. Og et arbejdsliv, hvor du kan mærke, at det du laver, gør en forskel for mennesker, du måske aldrig møder.

Hvis du vil arbejde et sted, hvor samarbejde er nødvendigt, udvikling sker midt i driften, og opgaven altid starter hos borgeren, så er der plads til dig hos os.

Dagligdagen i Præhospitalt Center kan være meget omskiftelig med uforudsigelige opgaver. Tag gerne et kig på vores Facebook, LinkedIn og Instagram-profil, hvor du kan følge med i hverdagen i Præhospitalt Center.

Ansættelsen er betinget af modtagelse af tilfredsstillende børneattest, Ansættelsen er betinget af modtagelse af tilfredsstillende straffeattest til privat brug

Ansættelsesområde

Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden bliver den 1. januar 2027 til Region Østdanmark som følge af sundhedsreformen. Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Region Østdanmark med alle tilhørende organisatoriske enheder.
Læs mere om betydningen af ansættelsesområdet på Region Østdanmarks hjemmeside.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.
Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Region Sjælland

Vi er regionens største arbejdsplads med mere end 21.000 medarbejdere og et budget på 23 mia. kroner. Vi løser opgaver inden for sundhed, psykiatri og regional udvikling og driver en række sociale institutioner. Klik ind på og læs mere om regionens opgaver, struktur og geografi. Du finder os også på Facebook, Twitter og LinkedIn.

title: Founding Engineer
description:
Founding Full-Stack Engineer

About Lygos:

We're Lygos, the team building the next new standard for Bitcoin collateral. Our mission is to unlock secure, transparent, and verifiable Bitcoin-backed credit markets.

We’re starting by developing a fundamentally new platform for Bitcoin-collateralized lending, leveraging Discreet Log Contracts (DLCs) to minimize counterparty risk and ensure borrowers maintain control of their Bitcoin.

Our founding team brings deep expertise from Anchorage Digital, StarkWare, ConsenSys, Shopify, and JPMorgan, backed by industry-leading investors, including Initialized and ConsenSys.

We’re an agile, highly motivated team seeking passionate builders ready to shape the future of Bitcoin finance.

The Opportunity:

As a Founding Full-Stack Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and building the Lygos platform and stack. It's a chance to be a core part of a foundational team, contribute to key architectural decisions, and grow with a company offering generous equity for early team members. You'll work directly with our experienced CTO and founding team to bring our innovative Bitcoin-native financial products to life.

Job Type:

  • Full-time, permanent role.

  • Fully remote opportunity with flexible hours.

  • (Optional: Office space available in Toronto for those who prefer hybrid work.)

What You'll Do:

  • Build & Innovate: Design, develop, and deploy core features for the Lygos platform, spanning our backend services, oracle infrastructure, and borrower-facing applications.

  • Full-Stack Development: Work across our entire stack, including TypeScript/Node.js backend services, database management (SQL/NoSQL), and potentially contributing to our React Native mobile application.

  • Bitcoin & DLC Integration: Implement and enhance functionality related to Bitcoin transactions, PSBTs, and the integration of Discreet Log Contracts. You'll be working with cutting-edge Bitcoin contract technology.

  • Oracle & Watchtower Systems: Contribute to the development and maintenance of our oracle systems for price attestations and event monitoring, as well as related infrastructure like watchtowers and notification services.

  • Architectural Input: Collaborate on platform architecture discussions, helping to design scalable, secure, and robust systems.

  • Embrace the Challenge: Be ready to wear multiple hats, tackle diverse challenges, learn quickly, and contribute proactively in a fast-paced environment.

What We're Looking For (Requirements):

  • Hungry & Motivated: You are driven, proactive, and excited by the challenge of building something impactful from the ground up in a small, fast-moving team.

  • Strong TypeScript & Node.js Experience: Proven ability to build robust backend services.

  • Full-Stack Versatility: Comfortable working on both backend logic and potentially contributing to frontend components.

  • Database Proficiency: Experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MongoDB).

  • Independent & Proactive: Ability to work independently, take ownership, and figure things out with minimal oversight.

  • Quick Learner: Eagerness and ability to dive into an existing codebase and rapidly learn new technologies and concepts, especially around DLCs.

  • Excellent Communicator & Team Player: You thrive in a collaborative environment.

Nice-to-Haves (Bonus Points):

  • Direct experience with Bitcoin development and advanced scripting.

  • Good technical grasp of Bitcoin's blockchain architecture, the UTXO model, transactions, and ideally some familiarity with Bitcoin libraries (e.g., bitcoinjs-lib, working with PSBTs).

  • Knowledge of Discreet Log Contracts (DLCs) or other advanced Bitcoin contract types (big plus, but we will provide resources and training if you have a strong Bitcoin foundation).

  • Experience with blockchain oracles or multi-signature setups.

  • React Native experience.

  • Familiarity with Rust or C++ (relevant to Bitcoin/DLC libraries).

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS, GCP) and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Experience at an early stage startup.

Why Join Lygos?

  • Founding Team Impact: As our first engineering hire, you'll have a direct, significant impact on the product, technology, and company culture.

  • Generous Equity: We believe in aligning incentives and are offering a substantial equity stake for early, key team members. Your success is our success.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer highly competitive salaries to attract and retain the best talent in the industry.

  • Cutting-Edge Technology: Work at the forefront of Bitcoin innovation with Discreet Log Contracts.

  • Experienced Leadership: Learn from and collaborate with a founding team that has deep expertise in both institutional finance and pioneering DLC technology.

  • Massive Market Opportunity: Help build a foundational layer for the future of Bitcoin finance.

  • Remote & Flexible: Enjoy the benefits of a fully remote setup, with opportunities to collaborate in-person

Our Typical Interview Process

  • Initial Application. Fill out the short form so we can get to know you!

  • 1-2 chats. Discuss our vision, check for culture fit, talk about your past experience, get to know each other more in-depth. Feel free to ask us questions as well!

  • Complete a paid take-home assignment. We’ll have you work on a small project relevant to our infrastructure that we’ll review.

  • 2-way reference check. You chat with our investors and team members. We chat with previous (or current) coworkers/managers.

  • Offer.

Ready to build the future of Bitcoin finance with us? Apply now and we'll get back to you as soon as we can!

Vi tager gerne en uformel snak.

Ansøgning og CV sendes via "Søg Stillingen" knappen nede til højre, eller ved at kontakte Rene på tlf direkte.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig og få dig med på holdet!

Velkommen til Frimann Hansen Automobiler A/S

Frimann Hansen Automobiler A/S er i dag en fusion mellem de tidligere forretninger Frimann Biler A/S og Henrik Hansen Automobiler A/S.
Forretningen består af fire afdelinger i henholdsvis Næstved, Vordingborg, Nykøbing Falster og Slagelse, hvor vi er forhandlere af ni bilmærker.

**Vores medarbejdere har styringen
**Kernen i vores forretning er uden tvivl vores medarbejderstab, der sætter sig i førersædet for at kunne yde den bedst mulige kundeservice. De arbejder altid ud fra de fem vigtige værdier – smil, respekt, gennemsigtighed, fleksibilitet og gode kundeoplevelser.

Værdierne gør, at vores medarbejdere hver dag yder en ekstraordinær service, som både skaber glæde mellem kunder og blandt medarbejderne selv.

”Medarbejderne er dem, som er styrken og er skyld i vores mangeårige succes. Langt de fleste er udlært her, og flere har været ansat i både 15, 20 og 25 år. De har et kæmpe knowhow og et erfaringsniveau som er uerstatteligt – og som gør det nemt at drive forretningen. Vi har kunder i hele landet, men primært kunder i vores lokalområde, som kommer igen og igen – ikke mindst på grund af vores dygtige medarbejdere.”
– Kristian Hansen.

Udover dygtige medarbejdere, har vi spurgt os selv om, hvad vi ville forvente som kunde hos Frimann Hansen Automobiler. Svaret var: Fornuftige købs- og byttepriser, fornuftige værkstedspriser, og så tillid til, at min bil bliver behandlet, som om det var jeres egen.

For os er det derfor afgørende at kunne tilbyde konkurrencedygtige priser og yde en service, hvor du som kunde kan føle dig tryg hele vejen igennem.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
Overview

At eimagine, we know that your best work happens when you live your best life and share your unique talents, so we do everything we can to be intentional in a remote-enabled environment to make that possible. Recognized as a Best Places to Work since 2015, we are a team of humbly confident people who are proud of their craft, continuous learners, and enthusiastic supporters of one another.For over 24 years, we have helped clients navigate technology and business change while delivering meaningful outcomes.

Due to our continued growth, we are seeking a Project Coordinator to support project delivery teams and help ensure the successful execution of client engagements.

This role is ideal for someone early in their project management career who enjoys organization, communication, problem-solving, and working closely with both clients and project teams. You will partner with Project Managers, consultants, and clients to coordinate project activities, track progress, manage project documentation, and help facilitate successful project delivery.

Description of Duties

  • Support Project Managers in planning, coordinating, and delivering client projects.
  • Maintain project schedules, timelines, action items, and project documentation.
  • Track project milestones and task progress using tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Project, or similar platforms.
  • Coordinate project meetings, including agendas, notes, action items, and follow-up communications.
  • Assist with project status reporting and preparation of client-facing updates.
  • Maintain project artifacts in accordance with eimagine Trust Advantage (eTA) standards and templates.
  • Monitor project risks, issues, and dependencies and escalate concerns appropriately.
  • Support change request documentation and project governance processes.
  • Facilitate communication between project team members, clients, and stakeholders.
  • Help coordinate project resource needs and allocation updates.
  • Maintain accurate project and resource information within OpenAir and other project management systems.
  • Assist with sprint ceremonies, including standups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and planning meetings.
  • Prepare meeting materials, training documentation, and presentation content as needed.
  • Track and report project metrics and key performance indicators.
  • Ensure compliance with customer requirements, project standards, and internal delivery processes.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives related to project delivery and operational processes.
  • Build strong working relationships with clients and internal team members.
  • Perform administrative and coordination activities necessary to support successful project execution.

Desired Skills & Experience

  • 1+ years of experience in project coordination, project management, business analysis, operations, consulting, or a related role.
  • Experience supporting technology projects or software development initiatives preferred.
  • Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, or traditional project management methodologies.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Detail-oriented with strong follow-through and problem-solving abilities.
  • Experience creating project documentation, status reports, meeting notes, and project plans.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Teams.
  • Experience with Microsoft Project, Jira, Azure DevOps, SharePoint, or similar project management tools is a plus.
  • PMP, CAPM, Scrum Master, or other project management certifications are a plus but not required.
  • Consulting experience is a plus.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, Information Technology, or a related field preferred.

title: Trailer Management
description:
Job description:

About the Role

GH Logistics is seeking a highly organized and results-driven Trailer Asset Manager to oversee the daily management of our trailer fleet in San Antonio. This leadership role is ideal for someone who excels at asset management, vendor oversight, operational efficiency, and leading teams in a fast-paced transportation environment.

This is not a mechanic position. We’re looking for a leader who can manage the operation, not perform the repairs. You’ll be responsible for ensuring trailers remain operational, vendors stay accountable, and fleet data remains accurate to support daily operations.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and maintain the company’s trailer fleet and asset management system.
  • Oversee the complete trailer repair lifecycle from identification through return to service.
  • Coordinate with third-party maintenance vendors and hold them accountable for repair quality and turnaround times.
  • Monitor trailer utilization, condition, movement, and inventory.
  • Lead and support yard personnel while driving accountability and performance.
  • Maintain accurate reporting and fleet records.
  • Collaborate with operations to minimize downtime and maximize equipment availability.
  • Identify and implement process improvements that increase efficiency and reduce costs.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in fleet, trailer, transportation, or asset management.
  • Previous leadership or supervisory experience.
  • Experience using fleet management software such as Fleetio, Geotab, AssetWorks, or similar platforms.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience managing vendors and outside service providers.
  • Excellent communication and leadership abilities.
  • Ability to work on-site in San Antonio, TX

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing trailer fleets in a transportation or logistics environment.
  • Knowledge of DOT regulations and trailer inspections.
  • Experience improving operational processes and asset utilization.

Benefits

  • Starting salary of $65,000 per year.
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance.
  • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays.
  • Career advancement opportunities.
  • Leadership position with significant impact on company operations.

If you’re a proactive leader who enjoys building efficient systems, leading teams, and taking ownership of critical operations, we’d love to hear from you

Benefits:

  • 401(k)
  • Dental insurance
  • Health insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

  • Have you managed outside maintenance/repair vendors?
  • Are you comfortable managing repairs and vendors rather than performing mechanical repairs yourself?

Shift availability:

  • Overnight Shift (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Verksamhetsutvecklare till socialförvaltningen
description:
Vill du ha meningsfulla arbetsuppgifter som gör skillnad i människors liv? Välkommen till kommunen som är långt ifrån lagom!

Socialförvaltningen ger stöd till Botkyrkaborna och ansvarar för myndighetsutövning, i första hand enligt socialtjänstlagen. Stödet är både för individ och närstående. Socialförvaltningen har ett särskilt ansvar för barn, unga och vuxna i behov av stöd enligt sociallagstiftningen. Vi är ungefär 500 medarbetare som med styrkebaserade arbetssätt ger stöd till Botkyrkaborna på ett jämlikt, rättvist och tryggt sätt.

Läs mer om socialförvaltningen här: https://www.botkyrka.se/dinbastaarbetsplats

Tjänsten och arbetsuppgifterna

Nu söker vi en verksamhetsutvecklare/utredare till stöd- och utvecklingsenheten. Här får du arbeta med analys och utveckling, följa upp resultat och omsätta dina slutsatser i förslag som hjälper socialförvaltningen att utveckla sin verksamhet.

Som verksamhetsutvecklare/utredare arbetar du strategiskt och förvaltningsövergripande på uppdrag av socialnämnden och förvaltningsledningen, med nära koppling till förvaltningens verksamheter. Du stöttar chefer och förvaltningsledning i planering och uppföljning och tar fram underlag som hjälper förvaltningen att förstå resultat, se utvecklingsbehov och fatta välgrundade beslut. Du arbetar bland annat med måluppföljning, delårsrapporter och det systematiska kvalitetsarbetet och följer upp och analyserar verksamhetens resultat.

I din roll ingår också att

  • samordna arbetet med socialnämndens statsbidrag, innebärande att genomföra ansökningar och återrapportering samt regelbunden uppföljning.
  • genomföra utredningar som rör exempelvis lex Sarah, uppdrag från nämnden eller yttrande över revisionsgranskningar.
  • ingå i olika arbetsgrupper och nätverk.

För att kunna ge relevant stöd behöver du följa utvecklingen inom området samt hålla dig uppdaterad om lagstiftning och andra förutsättningar som påverkar socialförvaltningens arbete. Uppdragen varierar över tid, så du behöver kunna växla mellan löpande uppföljning, utredningar och utvecklingsarbete utifrån förvaltningens behov.

Vi erbjuder dig

Socialförvaltningen i Botkyrka präglas av kompetens, engagemang och vilja till utveckling. Vi är en progressiv organisation och har många spännande samarbeten med andra myndigheter och med civilsamhället. Stöd- och utvecklingsenheten ger service och stöd till socialförvaltningens ledning, chefer och verksamheter. Här finns utöver tre verksamhetsutvecklare även stödfunktioner inom IT, juridik, kommunikation, nämndsekretariat samt registratur och arkiv.

Vi erbjuder dig ett självständigt arbete i en framåtsträvande enhet där du får möjlighet att vara med att utveckla framtidens socialtjänst. Vi värdesätter flexibilitet och erbjuder både flexibla arbetstider och distansarbete när arbetet tillåter samt goda möjligheter till kompetensutveckling. Du blir en del av en funktion med högt förtroende i organisationen och en central roll i utvecklingen av framtidens socialtjänst. Hos oss får du arbeta med komplexa och samhällsviktiga frågor där ditt arbete gör konkret skillnad för kommunens invånare.

Du som söker till oss

Vi söker dig som har högskoleexamen inom exempelvis socialt arbete, statsvetenskap eller samhällsvetenskap, alternativt annan högskoleutbildning som vi bedömer som likvärdig. Du har flerårig erfarenhet av utrednings- och utvecklingsarbete och uttrycker dig väl på svenska i både tal och skrift. Du är också van vid att presentera information och tala inför både små och stora grupper.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av

  • Planerings- och uppföljningsarbete inom kommunal verksamhet.
  • Arbete inom socialtjänsten.
  • Att bearbeta och analysera statistik som underlag för verksamhetsutveckling.
  • Systematiskt kvalitetsarbete.
  • Arbete med statsbidrag.
  • Systemen Stratsys, 2c8, Lifecare och Public 360.

För att trivas och lyckas i rollen behöver du vara analytisk och strukturerad. Du sätter dig snabbt in i nya frågor, analyserar underlag och ser samband mellan mål, resultat och verksamhetens behov. Du kan förklara dina slutsatser på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt, så att chefer och kollegor förstår vad uppföljningar och utredningar visar och hur resultaten kan användas i verksamheten. Du planerar och prioriterar mellan olika uppdrag och kan växla mellan exempelvis måluppföljning, statsbidrag och utredningar utan att tappa helheten.

När du ser behov av utveckling tar du initiativ och driver arbetet vidare från analys till förslag och uppföljning. Du samarbetar nära med chefer och kollegor, lyssnar in verksamhetens behov och tar tillvara olika perspektiv. På så sätt bidrar du till att utveckla arbetssätt och ta fram förslag som fungerar i socialförvaltningens vardag.

Välkommen in med din ansökan!

För tjänster på Socialförvaltningen i Botkyrka kommun kommer du som blivande medarbetare att genomgå en bakgrundskontroll.

Läs mer om bakgrundskontroller här: https://www.botkyrka.se/bakgrundskontroll

Om oss

Botkyrka är en kommun full av kontraster där storstadens förortsmiljö möter landsbygdens skogar, ängar, sjöar och havskust. Här talas över 100 språk, här bor och arbetar människor med bakgrund från hela världen.

Vi erbjuder en inspirerande arbetsplats full av möjligheter där vi tillsammans skapar de bästa förutsättningarna för en hållbar framtid.

Vi har goda och trygga arbetsvillkor med kollektivavtal och flera förmåner för att du ska trivas och utvecklas på jobbet. I Botkyrka kommun fastställs lönen för en tjänst utifrån arbetsuppgifternas innehåll, ansvar, svårighetsgrad och de krav som ställs i rollen. Löneintervallet tas fram med utgångspunkt i dessa faktorer och kommunens lönestruktur. Läs mer här: Vårt arbetsgivarerbjudande

Övrig information

Botkyrka kommun omfattas av offentlighetsprincipen. Det innebär att ansökningshandlingar som huvudregel är allmänna handlingar.

Vi arbetar med kompetensbaserad rekrytering för att kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsprocessen och därmed motverka diskriminering.

Vi undanber oss kontakt från rekryterings- och bemanningsföretag i samband med denna rekrytering.

title: AI Agent Engineer, Client Experience
description:
Company Overview

Orbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies. We convert complex information and operational systems into decisive outcomes, giving public institutions and critical enterprises the tools to move faster, see clearer, and act first in an increasingly contested world.

We are not a consulting firm and not a systems integrator. Every Orbis team is built around practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, and every engagement is judged on one thing: whether it produces working capability, not slide decks. Solutions forged from experience; that is how we build, and it is how we hire.

Job Summary

Orbis is building the agentic AI capability its mission support operations run on, and the AI Agent Engineer builds and operates it. Sixty percent of this role is common to every AI Agent Engineer at Orbis: designing, building, and deploying the multi-agent workflows behind triage, data retrieval, summarization, reporting, and escalation routing. The remaining forty percent is this role's focus — owning how clients get support on Orbis products already in the field. This engineer owns the Mission Support Desk (MSD) workflows behind client requests — intake, triage, escalation, and resolution — operates the client-facing surfaces those workflows run on, and holds the response and resolution commitments Orbis makes on deployed products.

Travel: Occasional (up to 10%), which may include international travel.

Key Responsibilities — Common Core (60% of the Role)

Every AI Agent Engineer at Orbis, regardless of focus area, owns the following:

  • Design, build, and deploy agentic AI workflows. Architect and ship the multi-agent and automated workflows that run in production: triage, data retrieval, summarization, reporting, and escalation routing.
  • Translate in both directions. Explain to non-technical stakeholders what the systems do, where they are reliable, and where they are not, in terms those stakeholders can act on. Equally, take a process owner's plain-language description of how their work happens and turn it into a workflow specification that holds up.
  • Partner with process owners to build what they actually need. Work directly and iteratively with the colleagues who own a process so the resulting capability fits their operation rather than forcing them to fit it. Push back constructively when a stated requirement will not survive contact with production.
  • Keep the workflows reliable. Monitor what is running in production, diagnose failures across prompts, tools, data, and orchestration, and resolve them. Know which problems are yours to solve and when to bring in engineering.
  • Own the cost of execution. Track what your AI workloads cost to run. Identify where a tighter prompt, a caching layer, or a simple deterministic step delivers the same outcome, and keep those costs defensible as volume grows.
  • Set the quality bar for AI-assisted output. Define accuracy standards, human review checkpoints, and escalation criteria for the automated workflows, and build the checks that prove those standards are being met.
  • Document what you build. Author and maintain the runbooks and SOPs that allow others to operate and troubleshoot these workflows without you. Nothing lives only in one person's head.
  • Integrate across Orbis products. Work across Catalyst, Pulse, and Discovery, with engineering support where needed, so workflows can access and act on the data they require.
  • Deliver the reporting leadership and the team depend on. Build and maintain the outputs behind resolution rate, escalation rate, output accuracy, response time, and employee satisfaction, and turn the Senior Operations Manager's requirements into structured, recurring reports and data exports.
  • Close capability gaps and keep the practice current. Recognize when a need is not served by existing tooling, scope the gap clearly, and either build it or bring it to engineering and product with enough detail to act on. Track developments in agentic AI tooling and enterprise automation platforms, and form a defensible view on what is worth adopting, at what pace, and for which use cases.

Focus Area — Client Experience (40% of the Role)

In addition to the common core above, this role owns what the client sees and touches:

  • Build and operate the external-facing interfaces and portals through which clients interact with Orbis capability.
  • Design and automate client onboarding: provisioning, configuration, and the first-run experience.
  • Build the support workflows behind client requests — intake, triage, escalation, and resolution — and instrument them so performance is measurable.
  • Hold the reliability and accuracy bar on anything client-facing, including documented failure modes and response commitments.
  • Turn client friction into product change: capture where clients struggle and carry it back to engineering and product with enough detail to act on.
  • Maintain the client-facing documentation, release notes, and status communication that keep clients informed without a support request.

Required Qualifications

Orbis weighs what a candidate has built over tenure or credentials. The following are true minimum requirements for this role:

  • Must have 5 years proven experience translating user requirements into wireframes, workflows and such.
  • Must have 1-year proven experience utilizing Claude or similar commercial offering to build AI agents.
  • Demonstrated experience building a functioning multi-agent workflow, with the ability to walk through the design rationale, how the agents hand off work and share context, what broke, and how it was fixed
  • Practical command of prompt engineering, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and tool or function calling
  • Proven ability to explain technical work to non-technical audiences — describing a system's behavior, limits, and failure modes to a process owner or executive without hedging or retreating into jargon
  • Demonstrated ability to elicit requirements from stakeholders who cannot hand over a specification, and to reach a working solution regardless
  • Ability to troubleshoot agent workflows built on platforms such as Claude, GPT-class models, LangChain, AutoGen, or CrewAI, and to isolate whether a failure originates in the prompt, the tool, the data, or the orchestration
  • Working proficiency with APIs and sufficient scripting ability to build and debug workflows independently; software engineering experience is not required, but a JSON payload or a Python script must not be a blocker
  • Sound judgment about model output, including the discipline to state plainly when an output should not be trusted
  • Strong written communication. This role produces documentation, runbooks, and reports that program leads and executives rely on
  • Experience building and operating external-facing interfaces, portals, or client-facing applications in production
  • Experience designing or automating customer onboarding and provisioning
  • Experience designing support workflows — intake, triage, escalation, resolution — and instrumenting them so performance is measurable

Desired Qualifications

Strong candidates will bring depth in one or more of the following. Do not screen yourself out for lacking items on this list.

  • 5-7 years experience in software development
  • Experience coding using Python
  • Interface build: a modern front-end framework such as React; API design for external consumers; accessibility and usability practice
  • Support tooling: integration with ticketing or CRM platforms such as Zendesk, ServiceNow, or Jira Service Management
  • Client accountability: defining and reporting against service commitments; running client feedback loops or usability research
  • Bridging technical and operational teams: prior work as a solutions consultant, technical program manager, forward-deployed engineer, or in a product-adjacent role
  • AI reliability practice: monitoring, evaluation, or observability tooling for AI systems in production; automated evaluations or regression checks for LLM-based workflows; human-in-the-loop review steps that maintain quality without creating bottlenecks
  • Process design: designing SOPs or escalation frameworks that hold up across multiple stakeholders
  • AI-assisted development tooling: working fluency with Claude, Copilot, or Cursor
  • Mission environment: operating within or supporting a government or defense program; OSINT, DIGINT, or intelligence analysis workflows and tradecraft; data governance concepts, federated access control models, or zero-trust architectures
  • Operating range: a track record of coming up to speed quickly on unfamiliar systems, and effectiveness in a distributed, multi-program environment with competing priorities

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer

title: Substation Project Manager
description:

Responsible for the deliverables associated with substation design projects supporting one of our largest electric utility clients. This includes tracking/resolving action items, information requests and assisting the design team in the resolution of technical issues as required.

Required

Preferred

The Salary range for this position is $140,000 to $165,000. The starting salary will be commensurate with skill, education, experience, and working environment.

  • Ability to sit/ stand for up to 8 hours per day.

Local Candidates only

Yes

  • Indigenous Relationships

Geographic representation is important to further our biodiversity goals in the Kootenays, North and Central Interior, South Okanagan, Greater Vancouver & the Fraser Valley, Vancouver Island and the Gulf Islands.

NTBC is currently looking to add:

  • 2 Board members (June 2027)
  • New Committee members especially in Indigenous Relationships and Fundraising.

Commitment

The Board holds two half-day remote and two in-person meetings a year (one full day meeting in Vancouver and one 2-3 day trip elsewhere in BC). Ad hoc remote meetings may be scheduled throughout the year. Each Board member is also asked to join a Board Committee which meets virtually 4 times per year. Directors are also asked to attend NTBC fundraising events in their area.

Board members are appointed annually at the June Annual General Meeting; Directors are eligible for a maximum of eight, one-year terms.

Committee members may be appointed as non-Director members. This is a great way to contribute your expertise, get acquainted with NTBC, and create a stepping stone to Board membership.

How to apply

We welcome expressions of interest from leaders who are passionate about conserving BC’s natural habitats through land protection, restoration, and management. We especially encourage applications from:

  • Indigenous leaders
  • Women leaders
  • Mid-Career leaders
  • Leaders that live or work in the Kootenays

Please submit a brief bio/letter identifying the relevant skills that you would bring to the Board or Committee, your interest in NTBC, plus a professional bio or resume.

Applications will be reviewed through November 2026, with top candidates being contacted by December 2026 to begin the interview process. Applicants will be kept in the pipeline for future Board and Committee recruitment.

We encourage applications from underrepresented communities in the environmental sector, including racialized persons, Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons identifying as 2SLGBTQIA+, and all those who contribute to a diverse society.

title: Project Controls Senior Scheduler
description:
About Us

At ENFRA, we blend a rich history with a forward-looking vision. With over 100 years of experience, we are a pillar of stability in the energy infrastructure industry and a leader in innovative energy solutions. Our commitment to leveraging emerging technologies ensures that we remain at the forefront of the Energy-as-a-Service sector.

We believe in growth—not just for our business, but for our people. Our team members have the opportunity to advance their careers in a supportive environment that values continuous learning and development. We embrace innovation and encourage creative problem solving to tackle the energy infrastructure and energy challenges of tomorrow.

Inclusion is at the heart of our culture. We strive to create a workplace where every voice is heard and valued, fostering a collaborative environment where diverse perspectives drive our success.

Join us to be part of a legacy of excellence and a future of groundbreaking advancements. At ENFRA, stability, innovation, and growth are more than just values—they are the pillars of our continued success.

Overview

Position Purpose

The Senior Project Scheduler is a senior individual contributor responsible for leading the development, maintenance, analysis, and integrity of Project Schedules throughout all phases of assigned projects. Working under the direction of the Project Controls Director, the role independently leads scheduling execution on large, complex, high-risk, or strategically important projects and may lead scheduling across multiple related projects. The Senior Project Scheduler also supports proposal and bid schedule development as required.

The Senior Project Scheduler develops project schedules from Level 1 milestone schedules through Level 4 detailed working schedules based on project execution strategy and the integration of information from internal stakeholders, subcontractors, clients, and other project participants. The position owns the scheduling process, identifies emerging issues, evaluates schedule performance, develops recommendations, and leads mitigation, corrective, recovery, acceleration, and claims-support activities.

The Senior Project Scheduler is considered a senior technical expert in planning and scheduling and must understand and communicate the relationships among estimating, engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, progress measurement, cost control, forecasting, risk management, change management, energy performance, and reporting. The role provides technical leadership and mentoring, challenges assumptions, and influences project outcomes while consistently applying enterprise Project Controls standards and methodologies.

Responsibilities

Duties & Responsibilities:

Project Leadership, Team Integration, and Project Setup

  • Serves as the senior scheduling lead and an active member of project leadership teams, providing timely, objective schedule information that supports financial, schedule, and execution decisions.
  • Leads cross-functional planning among Project Management, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Pre-Construction, Finance, subcontractors, clients, and Project Controls personnel to translate scope and execution strategy into integrated schedules.
  • Leads scheduling setup and mobilization for large or complex projects, including schedule architecture, work breakdown structures, calendars, coding, responsibility assignments, update cadence, and contractual requirements.
  • Reviews proposals, contracts, execution plans, and commercial requirements and ensures schedule obligations, milestones, constraints, and deliverables are clearly incorporated.
  • Independently diagnoses schedule challenges, evaluates root causes and downstream impacts, and leads development and implementation of mitigation and recovery actions.

Schedule Management

  • Develops, baselines, maintains, updates, and analyzes network-logic-driven schedules from proposal and Level 1 milestone plans through Level 4 detailed working schedules.
  • Serves as the senior Primavera P6 subject matter expert, responsible for configuration, administration, maintenance, quality assurance, and integrity of project schedules and related data.
  • Develops and integrates complex engineering, procurement, fabrication, construction, commissioning, subcontractor, client, and turnover schedules.
  • Leads schedule status collection and validation and ensures accurate updates to progress, remaining durations, logic, constraints, milestones, resources, quantities, and forecast completion dates in Primavera P6.
  • Performs advanced critical path, near-critical path, float, variance, milestone, resource, productivity, trend, and schedule health analysis to identify threats and opportunities.
  • Develops look-ahead schedules, narratives, manpower histograms, progress curves, key quantity curves, executive views, and other schedule products required to manage execution.
  • Leads schedule review and planning meetings and clearly communicates status, key drivers, constraints, decisions, and required actions.
  • Develops and evaluates mitigation, recovery, acceleration, and what-if scenarios and drives action plans through resolution.
  • Leads or provides technical support for schedule risk analysis, time impact analysis, delay analysis, prolongation, acceleration, and claims evaluations using detailed schedule models and contemporaneous records.
  • Ensures schedules meet enterprise, contractual, and project requirements and remain reliable tools for project and executive decision-making.
  • Provides technical guidance and training on Primavera P6, scheduling best practices, schedule governance, and enterprise scheduling standards.

Cost Management, Financial Performance, and Forecasting

  • Integrates schedule logic, progress, resources, quantities, and time-phased information with project cost, cash flow, forecasting, and Estimate-at-Completion processes.
  • Evaluates schedule trends and completion forecasts to identify potential cost, productivity, cash flow, revenue, and margin impacts.
  • Partners with Project Controls, Project Management, Finance, and Operations to align schedule assumptions with project and financial forecasts.
  • Provides advanced schedule-based analysis to support earned value, contingency, scenario planning, and management decisions.

Risk Management

  • Leads identification, assessment, quantification, documentation, and monitoring of schedule risks and opportunities and their cost and execution impacts.
  • Leads or supports qualitative and quantitative schedule risk analysis and provides recommendations for contingency and risk response decisions.
  • Develops and monitors schedule mitigation, contingency, and recovery strategies and communicates material changes in exposure.
  • Challenges schedule assumptions and promotes early identification and active management of risk.

Change Management

  • Leads the schedule component of change management, ensuring scope changes, trends, claims, and potential impacts are identified, evaluated, documented, and incorporated into schedules.
  • Develops and reviews time impact analyses, fragnet models, delay analyses, and time-related support for changes, prolongation, acceleration, recovery, and claims.
  • Maintains traceable schedule records, baselines, updates, narratives, and supporting documentation needed to substantiate project positions.
  • Coordinates with commercial and Project Controls stakeholders so approved changes are consistently reflected in cost, schedule, and forecast information.

Energy Management

  • Ensures energy production, savings, commissioning, performance verification, and related contractual milestones are incorporated into project schedules.
  • Partners with technical and project leaders to identify schedule risks or variances affecting energy commitments and leads development of schedule-related corrective actions.

Planning & Project Setup

  • Leads schedule development during proposals, project planning, and startup, including development of milestone, bid, baseline, and detailed execution schedules.
  • Facilitates planning sessions and converts execution strategy, constructability input, estimates, resource assumptions, and stakeholder commitments into an integrated schedule.
  • Develops schedule work breakdown structures, coding, calendars, logic standards, update procedures, progress rules, and reporting requirements.
  • Supports constructability planning, feasibility studies, project execution planning, and close-out reporting.

Interface with Operational Finance

  • Provides time-phased schedule, progress, resource, and completion information to support revenue recognition, margin, billing, cash, reforecasting, accruals, and month-end alignment.
  • Diagnoses differences between schedule performance, project forecasts, operational expectations, and financial reporting and supports timely resolution.
  • Provides project leadership and the Project Controls Director with clear recommendations regarding schedule-driven financial trends, risks, and opportunities.

Reporting & Performance Analytics

  • Develops, analyzes, and presents schedule reports, dashboards, KPIs, progress curves, resource histograms, milestone reports, critical path analyses, and executive narratives.
  • Performs advanced schedule quality and health reviews and directs correction of logic, constraint, float, progress, resource, and data-quality issues.
  • Presents schedule performance, risks, recovery strategies, and decisions required during client, project, portfolio, and executive reviews.
  • Ensures schedule reporting is traceable to source data and aligned with enterprise definitions, contractual requirements, and reporting cadence.

Team Leadership, Culture and Talent Development

  • Provides technical leadership, coaching, and mentoring to schedulers, Project Controls associates, specialists, cost engineers, analysts, and project team members.
  • Reviews schedule work products and coordinates day-to-day scheduling activities on assigned projects without assuming formal manager accountability.
  • Acts as a technical escalation point for complex scheduling issues and supports onboarding and development of less experienced personnel.
  • Promotes an ownership-driven culture in which scheduling professionals challenge assumptions, anticipate risk, and contribute directly to project outcomes.
  • Shares lessons learned, technical knowledge, and proven scheduling practices across the Project Controls community.

Standards, Tools, and Continuous Improvement

  • Applies and champions enterprise planning and scheduling standards, procedures, tools, systems, and methodologies.
  • Serves as a senior Primavera P6 subject matter expert for schedule structure, coding, calendars, configuration, governance, data integrity, and enterprise standards.
  • Uses Primavera P6 and schedule analytics and quality tools to perform health assessments and identify logic deficiencies, float suppression, constraints, progress anomalies, and other reliability concerns.
  • Develops and improves schedule templates, coding structures, reporting standards, dashboards, and best practices that promote consistency and transparency.
  • Provides guidance and training on Primavera P6 functionality, schedule management processes, and enterprise scheduling requirements.
  • Evaluates emerging scheduling technologies and methodologies and recommends practical improvements to Project Controls effectiveness.
  • Performs other Project Controls duties and supports special initiatives as assigned.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in construction management, engineering, project management, or related technical field or 4 years of experience in lieu of degree.
  • 8+ years of experience.
  • Demonstrates experience in Gantt charts, Critical Path Analysis and methodology.
  • Demonstrates effective leadership in the execution of planning/scheduling activities on projects.
  • Possesses excellent English oral and written communication skills.
  • Understands EPC/full-service project delivery processes.
  • Independent, pro-active, accurate, with strong analytical and organizing skills.
  • Implements and effectively use company-standard planning/scheduling systems such as Primavera.
  • Experience with Accumen Fuse is a plus but not required.
  • Detail-oriented and willing to tackle various ongoing projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to multitask and perform duties outside of the scope of work when necessary.

Travel Requirements:

  • 20-35% travel required for this position

ENFRA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer of Minorities, Women, Protected Veterans, and Individuals with Disabilities, and participates in the e-Verify program. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability, or any other classification protected by law.

title: Sekretariatschef - Dansk Psykoterapeutforening
description:
Sekretariatschef - Dansk Psykoterapeutforening

Vil du lede et engageret og fagligt stærkt sekretariat i udviklingen af en forening med voksende medlemstal, høje ambitioner og en vigtig samfundsmæssig dagsorden i arbejdet for mental sundhed og trivsel i Danmark?

Dansk Psykoterapeutforening har gennem de senere år oplevet en jævn medlemsvækst, som giver os endnu bedre muligheder for at styrke psykoterapeuters synlighed og anerkendelse. Som sekretariatschef får du en vigtig rolle i at omsætte mulighederne til konkrete resultater og større værdi for medlemmerne. Du bliver samtidig leder for et velfungerende sekretariat med dygtige og selvstændige medarbejdere, høj faglighed og et stort engagement, hvor vi oprigtigt vil hinanden og lægger vægt på nærvær og en uformel omgangstone.

Opgaverne - det du skal hos os

Som sekretariatschef får du det overordnede ansvar for ledelse, drift og udvikling af sekretariatet. Du skal sætte retning, prioritere på tværs og skabe fremdrift i drift og udvikling. I takt med foreningens vækst skal du samtidig videreudvikle arbejdsgangene, så organisationen bevarer en enkel og velfungerende struktur. Du bliver tæt sparringspartner for formanden og skal sikre professionel betjening af bestyrelsen, forretningsudvalget og foreningens frivilligudvalg. Du omsætter bestyrelsens ambitioner og beslutninger til realistiske indsatser og understøtter et velfungerende samspil mellem bestyrelsen, medlemmerne og sekretariatet.

Sammen med bestyrelsen og medarbejderne skal du styrke professionens synlighed og anerkendelse, udvikle medlemsværdien og skabe sammenhæng i arbejdet med uddannelser og faglig kvalitet. Du skal samle og udvikle professionen, styrke kvaliteten af de psykoterapeutiske uddannelser og øge kendskabet til psykoterapeuters kompetencer og samfundsmæssige bidrag. Du skal desuden understøtte ambitionen om en mere fremtrædende og anerkendt rolle for psykoterapi i sundheds- og velfærdssystemet gennem samarbejde med myndigheder, uddannelsesinstitutioner, faglige organisationer og internationale partnere.

Profilen - dét vi forventer af dig

Vi forventer, at du har ledelseserfaring og gerne økonomisk og organisatorisk forståelse for en medlemsforening. Du har politisk tæft, og erfaring med betjening af bestyrelser og frivilligudvalg er en fordel. Det samme gælder kendskab til psykoterapi og mental sundhed. Vigtigst er det, at du kan lede dygtige specialister, sætte dig ind i komplekse faglige områder og inddrage relevant viden med respekt for den psykoterapeutiske faglighed.

Du kan omsætte bestyrelsens visioner og beslutninger til klare prioriteringer og konkrete resultater. Du arbejder struktureret og dataorienteret, skaber overblik og fremdrift blandt mange aktiviteter og interessenter og kan professionalisere organisationen uden at skabe unødig kompleksitet. Du er relationsstærk og har dømmekraft til at navigere mellem forskellige interesser i en medlemsstyret organisation. Du skaber tillidsfulde samarbejder mellem bestyrelsen, medlemmerne, de frivillige og sekretariatet. Samtidig kommunikerer du klart og troværdigt og skaber forståelse og opbakning til foreningens dagsordener blandt medlemmer, samarbejdspartnere og centrale beslutningstagere.

Andet

Du kan læse mere om Dansk Psykoterapeutforening og stillingen i den uddybende stillings- og kompetenceprofil.

Forventet tiltrædelse: 1. januar 2027

Ansøgningsfrist: Søndag den 1. november 2026

For yderligere information og spørgsmål kontakt gerne formand, Christina Lehtinen, på telefon 2177 1402 eller partner i MUUSMANN, Jan Thomsen, på telefon 4040 7719.

title: Sygeplejersker til Børne- og Ungemodtagelsen, Hvidovre Hospital
description:
Børne- og ungemodtagelsen på Hvidovre Hospital søger sygeplejersker

Igen i år sender vi sygeplejersker videre på sundhedsplejerskeuddannelsen og en anden på barsel og derfor søger vi nu nye kollegaer. Vi søger sygeplejersker, der har lyst til at arbejde med børn, unge og deres familier i en afdeling, hvor ikke to dage er ens. To faste stillinger og et barselsvikariat 32-37 timer ugentligt med weekendvagter hver 3. weekend.

Børne-og Ungemodtagelsen på Hvidovre Hospital er en af landets største med ca. 22.000 henvendelser årligt. Patienthenvendelserne favner bredt, lige fra den nybagte familie med et ulykkeligt spædbarn som har brug for råd og vejledning, til børn med respiratoriske problemer eller akutte og livstruende tilstande som ex. sepsis og meningitis. Det er som oftest korte kontakter, hvor børnene bliver færdigbehandlet i afdelingen, ellers bliver de indlagt til observation eller videre behandling på vores sengeafdeling

Vi yder empatisk og kompetent sygepleje på et højt fagligt niveau og vi arbejder tæt sammen med afdelingens læger og sekretærer. Vi lægger stor vægt på tværfaglig vidensdeling, læring og undervisning og praktiserer det dagligt. Vi arbejder desuden med tværfaglig akut teamtræning som er obligatorisk og velintegreret i afdelingen. Her har vi fokus på roller, kommunikation og på at integrere den senest opdaterede viden og praksis inden for pædiatri.

Vi kan tilbyde dig

  • At blive inkluderet i en spændende arbejdsplads med uendelige udviklingsmuligheder, da pædiatri favner alle specialer.
  • En meget engageret personalegruppe af unge og erfarne kollegaer, der vægter et højt fagligt niveau, arbejdsglæde og god trivsel.
  • En bred klinisk pædiatrisk erfaring, som du har brug for hvis du overvejer at læse videre til sundhedsplejerske.
  • En grundig introduktion tilpasset dine behov i samarbejde med vores introduktionssygeplejerske samt obligatorisk undervisning og efterfølgende kompetenceudvikling.
  • Vi har fast faglig refleksion, tværfaglige tavlemøder i forbindelse med vagtskifte. Derudover har vi fast ugentlig undervisning for sygeplejersker og ugentlige tværfaglige konferencer for subspecialerne i afdelingen. Ved behov afholder vi debriefing/supervision omkring særlige forløb ved kritisk syge børn og unge.
  • En vagtplanlægger der selv er uddannet sygeplejerske og som derfor har øje for, at det at arbejde i skiftende vagter skal hænge sammen med familielivet.

Om dig

  • Du har lyst til at være med til at præge den faglige udvikling i den pædiatriske sygepleje.
  • Du trives med et højt patientflow og kan bevare overblikket.
  • Du er god til at kommunikere med mennesker i alle aldre og skabe tillid til børn, unge og voksne.
  • Du er åben, fleksibel, kreativ og initiativrig og er ikke bange for den legende og anderledes tilgang til patienterne.
  • Du vægter et godt kollegaskab højt.
  • Du skal kunne arbejde i treholdsskift.

Pædiatrisk erfaring er ikke et krav men en fordel. Vi har den holdning, at alle kommer med noget uanset om man er nyuddannet eller har erfaring fra andre specialer. Uanset hvad du kommer med, er viljen og lysten til at arbejde med børn og familier det vigtigste.

Ansøgning
Ansøgningsfrist er d. 23. oktober 2026.
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår følger overenskomst for ikke-ledende personale på Sundhedskartellets området indgået mellem Sundhedskartellets parter, herunder Dansk Sygeplejeråd og Regionernes Lønnings- og Takstnævn med lønindplacering som sygeplejerske uden specialuddannelse.

Har du lyst til at høre mere om vores afdeling eller lyst til at komme på besøg til en rundvisning, er du velkommen til at kontakte oversygeplejerske Helle Frost på telefon 26803705.

Læs mere om afdelinge her : https://www.hvidovrehospital.dk/afdelinger-og-klinikker/boerneafdelingen/Boernemodtagelsen/Sider/Boernemodtagelsen.aspx og følg os på instagram : boerneunge_modtagelsen_hvh

title: Software Engineer, Platform Engineering, Remote- Full-time
description:

You'll work on the internal tools, services, and workflows that power our operations, products, and AI-driven infrastructure.

title: IT Support Specialist
description:
Baltimore Country Club is looking to hire a full-time IT Support Specialist to join our Information Technology Department. This position offers a competitive wage based on skills and experience. We also provide a full benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, STD/LTD, and a 401(k) plan with a generous matching contribution, as well as free staff meals, an employee discount program, free golf on Mondays, and gym membership reimbursements! Are you an IT Support Specialist looking to start a new adventure? If so, apply today!

ABOUT BALTIMORE COUNTRY CLUB

Baltimore Country Club was founded in 1898 and was successful from the start, with 600 members enjoying its 150-acre facility less than five miles from downtown Baltimore. Just one year after opening, the Club gained immediate recognition in the golf world by hosting the fifth United States Open Championship. Today, the Club has nearly 3,400 members across two campuses. It is widely recognized as one of the top 50 country clubs in the nation and one of the top 100 in the world. We are committed to our Simple Truth: doing what is right, not what is easy.

A DAY IN THE LIFE AS AN IT SUPPORT SPECIALIST

As an IT Support Specialist, you will have the opportunity to interact with every department at the Club. Responsibilities include setting up computers and printers for new hires, providing access to shared files and printers, and configuring email accounts. Other duties include preparing for meetings and presentations that require projectors and audiovisual equipment, assisting with conference calls, and performing general maintenance, technical troubleshooting, and repairs on technology equipment.

This position will also be responsible for setting up and supporting audiovisual equipment for Club events, including TVs, projection systems, screens, sound equipment, and related AV technology. A strong understanding of basic AV setup and the ability to troubleshoot AV technology during meetings and events are important aspects of this role. The ideal candidate will have a positive, customer-service-oriented attitude, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. This position will support both the Roland Park Clubhouse and our Five Farms Clubhouse in Lutherville.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Two years of hands-on experience with networking and equipment deployment.
  • Understanding of basic computer and network concepts and terminology.
  • Basic knowledge of technology support, including the ability to set up, configure, and troubleshoot computers, peripherals, and other technology equipment.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office applications, including but not limited to Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Basic audiovisual event setup experience, including the ability to set up and support AV equipment for meetings and events.
  • Network+ certification and A+ certification, or equivalent experience and knowledge.
  • Strong technical troubleshooting skills and the ability to diagnose and resolve common technology issues.
  • Experience troubleshooting PCs, scanners, printers, and portable handheld terminals.
  • Ability to configure new or reimaged computer systems.
  • An associate degree or equivalent technical education, along with one to three years of experience working in a production environment.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS INCLUDE:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Comfort communicating in person and via phone or radio with colleagues, managers, and vendors.
  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods, potentially up to 10–12 hours.
  • Ability to lift up to 40 pounds.
  • Willingness to work a flexible schedule, including some evenings, weekends, and holidays, as required to support Club operations and events.
  • Flexibility in hours and availability, particularly during special events and periods of increased activity.
  • A highly motivated, member-centric attitude.
  • Ability to work independently and take initiative.
  • Ability to prioritize work based on departmental and operational objectives.
  • Willingness to perform other related duties as required.

Do you work well as part of a team? Do you have excellent customer service skills and a passion for hospitality? Do you have strong communication skills and the ability to learn and retain information quickly? Can you read and follow directions well? Are you quick on your feet and able to work in a fast-paced environment? Do you enjoy solving technology problems and feel comfortable supporting computers, AV equipment, and technology during events? If so, you might be the perfect fit for this IT Support Specialist position!

ARE YOU READY TO JOIN OUR COUNTRY CLUB INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY TEAM?

We understand that your time is valuable, which is why we offer a quick and easy application process. If you feel you would be a good fit for this position, please complete our initial three-minute, mobile-friendly application so we can review your information. We look forward to meeting you!

Equal Opportunity Employer

title: F&B Attendant - 1919 Restaurant at Condado Vanderbilt
description:
Overview

The Condado Collection is a collection of hospitality properties in Puerto Rico ranging from classic and modern luxury full-service hotels, to fine dining and entertainment.

The Condado Vanderbilt is the standard of excellence and luxury resort hotels in San Juan and The Caribbean. Originally built in 1919 and restored to its distinguished grandeur, offers unsurpassed cuisine, exquisite rooms and suites, and highly personalized service. We aim to create experiences and inspire journeys not only for our guests, but also our workforce. We are confident that our team members are the key in delivering passionate and authentic hospitality service. Let’s create a collection of memories together!

Key Responsibilities

  • Welcome and acknowledge every guest with warmth, professionalism, and genuine hospitality, following the restaurant’s service standards while anticipating and exceeding guest expectations through personalized and attentive service.
  • Deliver exceptional fine dining experiences by consistently executing all steps of service in accordance with the restaurant’s luxury standards and applicable Forbes Travel Guide service expectations.
  • Present and serve food and beverage orders with precision, elegance, and attention to detail, ensuring proper timing, presentation, temperature, and accuracy throughout the dining experience.
  • Demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of all menu items, ingredients, preparation methods, garnishes, allergens, dietary accommodations, and presentation, confidently guiding guests through their dining selections.
  • Describe menu items, daily specials, wine selections, and beverage offerings with clarity and sophistication, providing thoughtful recommendations tailored to individual guest preferences.
  • Anticipate guests’ needs by observing verbal and nonverbal cues, proactively replenishing beverages and table essentials, and ensuring every detail of the dining experience is attended to without unnecessary interruption.
  • Maintain expert knowledge of the restaurant’s Steps of Service, service etiquette, table maintenance, food and beverage presentation, and luxury hospitality protocols.
  • Prepare assigned service stations before opening, verifying the cleanliness and proper presentation of tables, chairs, table settings, service equipment, and all guest-facing areas.
  • Ensure all necessary service tools and equipment are properly maintained and readily available, including trays, pens, corkscrews, wine service tools, and other designated service essentials.
  • Maintain impeccable cleanliness, organization, and presentation of the dining room, service stations, side stations, and other assigned areas throughout the shift.
  • Execute wine and beverage service with professionalism and precision, demonstrating proper handling, presentation, and service techniques in accordance with established restaurant standards.
  • Coordinate effectively with culinary, bar, and service teams to ensure accurate order delivery, appropriate pacing between courses, timely communication of special requests, and seamless execution of each guest’s dining experience.
